Early on, my parents taught me that some things are always worth fighting for — no matter the opposition.

My dad helped found the first integrated law firm in North Carolina. He and his partners fought _against_ discrimination and _for_ equality. They kept up that fight even after extremists firebombed their office, burning it to the ground.

**Today, we’re once again at a crossroads. Extremists in North Carolina and across the country are threatening the values we hold most dear.**

Mark Robinson – a conspiracy theorist and far-right extremist – was just selected to lead the top of the ticket for NC’s GOP in November. He’s pushing for a total ban on abortion, promising to further strip funding for public schools, and threatening North Carolinians’ voting rights.

He’s also touted dangerous conspiracy theories: calling a school shooting survivor a “crisis actor,” questioning whether 9/11 was an inside job, and claiming the Holocaust was “hogwash.”

Mark Robinson is one of the most extreme statewide-elected Republicans _in the country_ – and yet the latest polls show us statistically TIED. The National GOP knows North Carolina is its top pickup opportunity, so we’re expecting them to flood money into our state to back Robinson.

| | Dear friends, family, and supporters, We did it! We won the primary! I’m officially moving on to the general election and we’re going to flip California’s 3rd Congressional District. Although election experts are estimating that only about half the votes have been counted, we are already seeing national enthusiasm for our race grow! I’ve been getting calls and texts from national political leaders throughout the day. It’s clear that the path to flip the House goes through the Sierra. I’m so grateful to each of you who have supported, volunteered and voted! This is truly a grassroots campaign. We are building this campaign together grounded on a deep love for our community and country. Your dedication has brought this campaign to life and your commitment is the reason we are going to win in November! [**Can you help us show strength as our general election campaign begins by making a donation to the campaign?**](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/grSBPcEXdUmedI9gPiKVJA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRny40HP0RtaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2ptY2EtMDMtZW1haWwtbWFyY2gyMDI0LWZyLW1hcmNoP3JlZmNvZGU9RTczNTItMjAyNDAzMDYtUG9zdFByaW1hcnlFbGVjdGlvblcDc3BjQgpl4x4I6WUcIQN-UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAALQ~~) In November there will be at least another 200,000 voters beyond the primary electorate. This is where we do the work. And this is where we win! We are going to work hard from today through Election Day to reach them, and I’m so grateful to have you on the team to do it! I’ll keep you updated as these results come in, but we can already confidently say that we have made this race competitive. Starting today, we are entirely focused on launching the general election and defeating Kiley in November! Please continue to contribute, sign up to volunteer and join us! Onward! We did it: I officially became the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas!
I am so grateful to my fellow Texas voters and grassroots supporters like you for entrusting me with this honor -- I will not let you down.
I'm ready to outwork Ted Cruz to win this thing because the stakes of this election are too high not to. From voting rights to abortion, our freedoms are under attack. Everyday costs are still too high. **Simply put: Texans cannot afford six more years of Ted Cruz.**
**That’s why this campaign is so important. Two recent polls showed us tied with Cruz, and I know we can win this race -- but I need you with me to do it. We're drawing a line in the sand.
Electing more Democrats in Oregon will only make our situation worse. The gaslighting, false narratives, government overreach and power grabs must come to an end. 2022 is the year we draw the line in the sand.

As the House Republican Leader in Oregon, I have seen first hand the communist agenda of Kate Brown, Joe Biden and Ron Wyden - it is earth shattering to see their desire to ruin our country and our state. They want Republicans gone from Oregon.

The consequences of Democrats in the Oregon Legislature and Governor Brown have proven to be devastating for our families and our small businesses for years, now they are taking aim at our children.

DON’T LET THEM WIN. We can make a difference, but it needs to be this year. It needs to start today.

You have witnessed the hypocrisy, the political “science”, and utter destruction of kids in the school system. You see the truth. You see past the teachers union bosses and the power grabbing state agencies in Oregon.

In 2022, we get an opportunity to change the leadership in Oregon.

You have the opportunity to send a message to Kate Brown and liberal democrats that they have done enough damage to our state and our children’s future with their never-ending attack on small business, enabling government overreach and mandating school shutdowns. Enough is enough!
<<HELP STOP THE DEMOCRATS!>> [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-vikki]

As the House Republican Leader, I am putting everything I have on the line. Will you help me win? Your contribution of $100, $250, $500, or $1000 is going to send a message - Enough.

Enough of Portland Democrats and liberal national agendas controlling our state. Portland Democrats can’t even control their own city from the nightly shootouts and rampant crime. They would rather put more criminals on the street, over hiring police to protect the citizens they were elected to serve.

National groups like the Republican State Leadership Committee are looking to turn the tide where it matters most—and Oregon is on their top-target list for the 2022 election.

We can WIN! But we need to raise $72,000 this month to reach critical deadlines.

Our team is ready to take majority in the Legislature and show that common-sense still has a place in our governing process. We are excited about our candidate recruitment effort this year; there is a path to victory. We have a campaign operation ready to win, but I need your help to do it.

Will you support me in making the strong effort to win in 2022? The RED WAVE is real, but we need to feed it, and push it to victory. We are going to every corner of the state–to every person who cares about the future of Oregon. Will you help? Will you be the difference in 2022 and bring balance to Oregon? We can win, but I need you today.

If you can make a contribution of $50, $250, $500, or even $1,000 to our fight, it will help us greatly in building a campaign effort that sends a message to Kate Brown, Joe Biden and socialist Democrat legislators–Not this year. Not Oregon.

For the future of Oregon.

Sincerely,

<<Vikki Breese Iverson Signature>> [https://026s4.mjt.lu/tplimg/026s4/b/1qm75/s4t3.png]

Vikki Breese-Iverson
House Republicans
Oregon State Representative for HD 59

I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom.
My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make
ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers,
coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football
scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.

But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I
wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what
I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly
served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas,
where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.

I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to
have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I
also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of
protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds
to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have
been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.

Now, I’m ready for my next challenge: firing Ted Cruz and being the voice
all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in
2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the
country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be
easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it
done, Derek.

Election Founding Donor and help reach our ambitious $1 million goal. We
need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Ted Cruz, and I’m
counting on you to be a part of it. Please, rush
$10, or
whatever you can spare, to help me and Adam Schiff win in Texas, defeat
Ted Cruz, and give Texans the leadership we deserve. →

Thank you so much for being a part of my team. Your support has gotten me
this far, and it's why I know we can win.

Let's do this,

Colin Allred

I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.

**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. | [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/63710?t=6&akid=13295%2E878179%2EZG3bal) **Friend, I’m incredibly humbled and honored to officially be the Democratic nominee for Governor of North Carolina.**

This grassroots team is incredible, and I’m so proud of the campaign we’re building together – one rooted in our shared values of freedom, fairness, and opportunity for all.

But let me be clear: We can’t let up. Not one bit.

[The next eight months will present challenge after challenge. We’re going to have to work hard every day to protect North Carolina – that’s why I’m counting on your help. The general election starts now: Will you split a contribution between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project now?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/63711?t=7&akid=13295%2E878179%2EZG3bal) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Stein and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/63712?t=8&akid=13295%2E878179%2EZG3bal)

Early on, my parents taught me that some things are always worth fighting for — no matter the opposition.

My dad helped found the first integrated law firm in North Carolina. He and his partners fought _against_ discrimination and _for_ equality. They kept up that fight even after extremists firebombed their office, burning it to the ground.

**Today, we’re once again at a crossroads. Extremists in North Carolina and across the country are threatening the values we hold most dear.**

Mark Robinson – a conspiracy theorist and far-right extremist – was just selected to lead the top of the ticket for NC’s GOP in November. He’s pushing for a total ban on abortion, promising to further strip funding for public schools, and threatening North Carolinians’ voting rights.

He’s also touted dangerous conspiracy theories: calling a school shooting survivor a “crisis actor,” questioning whether 9/11 was an inside job, and claiming the Holocaust was “hogwash.”

Mark Robinson is one of the most extreme statewide-elected Republicans _in the country_ – and yet the latest polls show us statistically TIED. The National GOP knows North Carolina is its top pickup opportunity, so we’re expecting them to flood money into our state to back Robinson.

[It will take everything we have to defeat Robinson and the National GOP on November 5th. Split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project now to help us win this toss-up race and defeat extremism in North Carolina →](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/63711?t=13&akid=13295%2E878179%2EZG3bal)

I’ve spent the past 25 years serving North Carolina. I’ve advocated for consumers mistreated by predatory corporations, worked to keep communities and families safe, and defended reproductive and voting rights.

North Carolina is our home. My wife Anna and I both grew up here. We raised our three kids here. They all went to North Carolina public schools, just like Anna and I did. I love this state and think it’s the best place to live, work, and raise a family.

[But far-right extremists are taking us down the wrong path. We can beat them with your help – please join us in the fight for North Carolina’s future by contributing whatever you can today.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/63711?t=19&akid=13295%2E878179%2EZG3bal)

Thank you to everyone who has supported our campaign so far and invested in our vision for a stronger, safer North Carolina. I can’t wait to continue in this fight together.

Let’s get going!

Josh Stein

I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. # WE MUST TURN OUT THE VOTE:
Hancock, Washington County Early Voting Site Nixed, Moved to Smithsburg.
,

Thanks to Washington County Commissioner Derek Harvey, who was lead plaintiff, and others, such as Republican attorney Adam Greivell, who worked hard to try and provide the City of Hancock in Western Maryland with an early voting site.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=9437935855&e=5bb5efcda7)
[Harvey recently told the Herald Mail newspaper in Hagerstown](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=6950bc8c19&e=5bb5efcda7), "I'm really not pleased with [the results] because the goal should have been to get people that have to drive the farthest, that don't have access, don't have public transportation available to them and is a traditionally poor part of the county, access to an early voting site."

This underscores why I need your help - we need to help our voters get to the polls and vote. We must overwhelm the turnout and that takes funds. With your help we have a plan to get out the vote and ensure Republicans win this seat in Congress which will be one of the most watched races in the nation.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=69bc3814d3&e=5bb5efcda7)
We need you now, even more than after the primary. Every dollar now and your early support now will help us provide the ground game to win. We need to reach every Republican voter in CD6 in the next thirty days. Mail-in voting begins April 1st and goes for 44 days through the May 14th election!

I cannot emphasize enough how crucial the fundraising is at this moment. [Each $100, $250, $500 or even $1776 will help us WIN BIG](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=c36b0c1efe&e=5bb5efcda7) \- TOO BIG TO RIG, like President Trump says. But we need you in order to do that. Thank you.

Freedom and Victory,
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=c8c7f5f5a4&e=5bb5efcda7)
Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (R-MD6)

P.S. Today, March 6, 1944 was the highest American casualty bombing run in WWII \- on this day we had 800 bombers, 10-15 American airman in each bomber, bomb Germany, including Berlin. We lost 150 men - mostly just boys - and 15 bombers in a single day. Don't let the far Left of today rob us of our freedom won by so many who gave so much for all of us. [Join us now](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=f07611e0c0&e=5bb5efcda7) and fight for our freedom. Thank you.

Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| | [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Good evening, It's been a big week in the political world, with a Trump sweep on Super Tuesday, Haley dropping out of the race, and more yet to come tomorrow with Joe Biden's State of the Union. Today's edition shares the highlights from yesterday's primary elections. This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, March 6, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Trump wins 57 of Colorado’s 64 counties in Super Tuesday rout of Haley**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
From the Western Slope to the Eastern Plains and from Fort Collins to Trinidad, on Super Tuesday former President Donald Trump garnered broad support from Colorado Republicans across the state. He won 57 of the state’s 64 counties, with more than half of those counties providing him at least 75% support. He won 20 counties – mostly in Eastern Colorado – with at least 80% support in a race that largely came down to Trump against former South Carolina Gov. Nikki Haley. Only 3.3% of Republican ballots supported someone other than Trump or Haley. The unofficial ballot count gave Trump 517,884 votes across Colorado to secure 63.3% of the vote, with Haley taking 273,809 for 33.45% support on an evening where Republicans in sixteen states and one territory weighed in on their choice for President. **How did your county vote? Click 'Read More' below for the county-by-county outcome.**
| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**‘They call it Super Tuesday for a reason,’ Trump says as he celebrates victory**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* President Donald Trump declared victory on Super Tuesday after winning in 15 out of 16 Republican Party primary elections.

* Nikki Haley suspended her campaign, leaving Trump with no major opponents.
Trump called for Haley's supporters to unify under his leadership on Truth Social, urging them to join what he describes as the greatest movement in U.S. history.

* Trump pledges to restore the economy, achieve energy independence, reduce the national debt, and promote unity following Haley's exit from the race, expressing confidence in winning the upcoming general election on Nov. 5, 2024.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Trump now faces ‘time of choosing’, Haley says as she suspends campaign**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Nikki Haley suspended her presidential campaign today. Without an endorsement, she called on Donald Trump, presumed Republican nominee, to earn the support of those who did not previously back him.

* Haley emphasized the importance of bringing more people into the conservative cause and expresses concern about America's national debt and the dysfunction in Congress. She warned against socialism, advocating for term limits for politicians, and stressed the need for America to maintain its leadership role in foreign affairs.

* While not formally endorsing Trump, Haley pledged to remain an advocate for conservative policies and emphasized the importance of unity in the country.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**‘Now that it’s over, it’s over,’ McConnell says in support of Trump following Haley exit**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Mitch McConnell endorsed Donald Trump for president following Nikki Haley's suspension of her campaign, marking a detente after three years of strained relations.

* The endorsement signifies a political alliance between McConnell and Trump, driven by their shared goal of regaining Republican control of the Senate and winning battleground states in the upcoming election. McConnell downplayed previous criticisms of Trump's conduct, focusing instead on the potential to oppose Democratic policies and improve the lives of Americans under a unified Republican leadership.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Bush-era ‘architect’ Karl Rove says Trump Team ‘ought to be concerned’ with party unification**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Republican strategist Karl Rove expressed concerns about the need to unify the Republican Party, despite acknowledging former President Trump's strong performance on Super Tuesday.

* Exit polls from Super Tuesday indicate that Trump may face challenges in winning over Nikki Haley's supporters, with a significant portion expressing reluctance to commit to voting for him in November.

* Trump responded to Rove's criticism by calling on Fox News to remove the political commentator from their programming, emphasizing his unparalleled record in endorsements and signaling potential tensions within the Republican Party.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---

| | **For immediate release** : March 6, 2024
**Contact** : press@davemin.com
**State Senator Dave Min’s Statement On CA47 Primary Results** IRVINE, CA — California State Senator Dave Min secured a decisive victory in Tuesday’s primary election, securing a top-two finish and sending a clear message that Democrats are ready to take back the House in 2024. Min’s triumph in Orange County not only underscores his resilience in a fiercely contested primary but also highlights his unwavering commitment to addressing the pressing concerns of Southern California families. **“I am deeply humbled and grateful for the support from voters across Orange County,”** said State Senator Dave Min. **“This victory is not just about winning an election, it is about the future we are collectively shaping. It's about reclaiming the House for Democrats and Orange County families. It’s about rejecting the divisive, Trump-supporting MAGA politics that our opponent, Scott Baugh, represents.** **It's about ensuring that our voices are heard loud and clear in Washington. I’m proud to be endorsed by law enforcement, fire fighters, teachers, nurses, and working families who I will fight for every day in Congress. Onwards to November!”** Min will face Republican Scott Baugh in November’s general election. Baugh has returned to the political arena after being rejected by CA47 voters in 2022. A career politician and right-wing extremist, he has consistently demonstrated a pattern of prioritizing his own personal interests while being influenced by [MAGA donors](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=f2a627e397&e=7017cc100e) and special interest groups, rather than effectively advocating for the needs of working families. Baugh has unequivocally voiced support for a [nationwide abortion ban](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5ba438cb0a&e=7017cc100e) [without exceptions](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=0d4c16889f&e=7017cc100e), even in cases of rape, incest, or when a woman's life is at risk, and has opposed safeguarding [same-sex marriage](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5f99b08537&e=7017cc100e) rights. During his time in the State Senate – where he represented over 80% of CA-47 – Min shepherded 28 bills into law, including legislation enshrining abortion rights in the California Constitution, expanding protections for domestic violence survivors, banning gun sales on state property, and addressing the causes of our climate crisis. In Congress, Dave Min will defend reproductive freedom nationwide, crack down on corporate price gouging, fight to lower health care costs, and always put Orange County taxpayers first. Headed into November, Min maintains a strong advantage thanks to his record as a bipartisan problem-solver, his history of electoral success within this same district, and his ability to overperform with his Democratic base. Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=754a13f1d1&e=7017cc100e). ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

A few years ago, members of the world’s elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, “We need a ‘Great Reset’ of capitalism.” If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that’s not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z72ih9v95ag5nnaclh2qlo74k69vdt483ir9s1b8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3g69pj6cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znpiigbe3mkl8c0bilgqsijaq6rvmb6l90391e88_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3g69pj6cph2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2hkf5pumg79lk2eka3sis65hg5r2dq8i2vvagd0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3g69pj6cph2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Fellow Patriots,
I am thrilled to announce that Dale Crafts, the 2020 Republican Nominee for Maine's Second Congressional District, has endorsed our campaign for Congress! "I'm proud to endorse Mike Soboleski for Congress. Mike has been an effective legislator and tireless advocate for his constituents at the State House. I have no doubt he will bring that same work ethic to Washington and be a great congressman for Maine's Second District. He has my full and complete endorsement."
I am so honored to have Dale's endorsement. He is a man of great faith with a wonderful family. I've always been impressed with his business acumen and commitment to public service. Having Dale Crafts on our team is a big reason why we are going to beat Jared Golden in November.
Experience matters. Our campaign is the one with life experience, business experience and military experience. It is gratifying to have great Republicans like Dale rally around our message of secure borders, lower taxes, less regulation and strong Second Amendment values.
-Mike

subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=481387aee3be4d73b2cfd11cf7a82fd1&_e=8vvNS20sH7xOs6h-Mi97TZ7odg8Ix5Il6u-gy_0VII3zqABUMut8Ujs-q70ASDyAbzthZoG-fp_PztVvEyMYn5ptfipqYpXTW038bZRUTIyFgk9ayhV8A_QfCDKIwQlLxRTzwy31Y17xeQVed2C6ci1uFD3cB9bW3pwsBZN5UcY3wvC1NbOwIfcNn2imjFtyjcHXMTLbIWTEHIKqzIoNsvNv4Cjq9B6qAo0LybLwO3JQx04sviXYChNf_Fm8BxCnwP3zt6gmPX82cfw_CDr-NSFHPU2EgqG-wLMa49XslFLC5CeOw9k-q4fdgVJo_5ITyPQ9e9alZNGUda4C108qbCLKl2EC_Hk14RcwoWAkmf15Rb4m-D_xbYwQTshtV5mkf3BHCY4_abQfx8D0wRhHJQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=481387aee3be4d73b2cfd11cf7a82fd1&_e=8vvNS20sH7xOs6h-Mi97TZ7odg8Ix5Il6u-gy_0VII3zqABUMut8Ujs-q70ASDyAbzthZoG-fp_PztVvEyMYn5ptfipqYpXTW038bZRUTIyFgk9ayhV8A_QfCDKIwQlLxRTzwy31Y17xeQVed2C6ci1uFD3cB9bW3pwsBZN5UcY3wvC1NbOwIfcNn2imjFtyjcHXMTLbIWTEHIKqzIoNsvNv4Cjq9B6qAo0LybLwO3JQx04sviXYChNf_Fm8BxCnvzIi9Hln7nCOnMz4_1x6bL0yvrfZElBYR9Bdos1aa9d_JWqLLMPzhA883wMwnKuZVe6cBLrn5yuxGVNT-v5q4CwkbiX3MeGQVlcUFsG2rqjI0t_D8MK6OMq2xPX4c53F5xdD2M0pXRNqD36bDKIjog%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=481387aee3be4d73b2cfd11cf7a82fd1&_e=8vvNS20sH7xOs6h-Mi97TZ7odg8Ix5Il6u-gy_0VII3zqABUMut8Ujs-q70ASDyAbzthZoG-fp_PztVvEyMYn5ptfipqYpXTW038bZRUTIyFgk9ayhV8A_QfCDKIwQlLxRTzwy31Y17xeQVed2C6ci1uFD3cB9bW3pwsBZN5UcY3wvC1NbOwIfcNn2imjFtyjcHXMTLbIWTEHIKqzIoNsvNv4Cjq9B6qAo0LybLwO3JQx04sviXYChNf_Fm8BxCnT6RzwWJfRwcrNkq4ZwqQ7jhpBj3F_QL5lA8dLtzfp50vkPZh-7nDpRDzmM9WupogA7mtpOW94QLMxFJpF2vckBY6CHYECHsyXxV1x1Yk1soEHd_kqIgGJXhbcKDwu1CGAv-w1yNQWzMI0H6yBvGpSA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Gold Dome Download March 7, 2024
Last week at the State Capitol saw Crossover Day: the deadline by which bills needed to pass one chamber (either the House or the Senate) to remain viable for further consideration. So in this week's edition of the Gold Dome Download, we'll recap all the legislation that did - and didn't - make it through. As of today, there are just 10 legislative days left until the end of Session, which will adjourn on March 28th. But still lots to come under the Gold Dome!
The deadline to vote early in Georgia's presidential primary election is also fast approaching. As a reminder, Election Day is next Tuesday, March 12th. You can vote early through this Friday. Find your polling location and hours by visiting [www.mvp.sos.ga.gov](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jooNqIwEsFggFlplJU8ljLZBHmxINaXjqFSWoH8aGVK834iTseSIisWrokfJDt0zfULs1kvSJgHpOegtWBC-r9Uht2q3wr4w13IM4wK1CZgIVvSCailKIHg3VUcedDv_6n4aHu5SNzT_7biz1kKARQ==&c=ls71UEdoyu3Bpb8Nkn23vO2ExwdzCvb_QuWdagFwNGlX9KAy_qbCHw==&ch=okNSheHkhiFzvlgV8iyHJ8Ip4HpeLywOFbcejfaIrma6e9eydcac9g==)!

| Other News to Know Democrats Defeat Bill to Ban Noncitizen Voting Late on Crossover night, Democrat lawmakers in the State House struck down a resolution to ban noncitizen voting in the state of Georgia. Although all Republicans voted for it, a two-thirds majority is required to pass and House Democrats were able to defeat the bill. Please note, it is illegal for noncitizens to vote in the state of Georgia - but this resolution would have prevented cities in the future from allowing noncitizens to vote in local elections. To view the full list of votes and to read the resolution, [CLICK HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jooNqIwEsFggFlplJU8ljLZBHmxINaXjqFSWoH8aGVK834iTseSIiggmr-af41j3RsWt_uAES0JuVOGmB7ZoXovYJdRkKaCmqkyzoxui0bCdknZL7DReNGu687I0WobZfE4WegD0DMcWcy3DoOC-4xolCyf6PNmaPjRTomniD9w=&c=ls71UEdoyu3Bpb8Nkn23vO2ExwdzCvb_QuWdagFwNGlX9KAy_qbCHw==&ch=okNSheHkhiFzvlgV8iyHJ8Ip4HpeLywOFbcejfaIrma6e9eydcac9g==).

So in this week's edition of the Gold Dome Download, we'll recap all the legislation that did - and didn't - make it through. As of today, there are just 10 legislative days left until the end of Session, which will adjourn on March 28th. But still lots to come under the Gold Dome! The deadline to vote early in Georgia's presidential primary election is also fast approaching. As a reminder, Election Day is next Tuesday, March 12th. You can vote early through this Friday. What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/abBZp28ECwSEqhQQ4i8kow~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/abBZp28ECwSEqhQQ4i8kow~~/AARclAA~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/abBZp28ECwSEqhQQ4i8kow~~/AARclAA~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

## Haley Suspends Campaign
Nikki Haley suspended her presidential campaign Wednesday, [ending her bid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGymzAQAL8GumPESUZxQZGGzmlTMmd0wMVC0kiyif_-jV_96i12Z__e5huJl7D9oYPHusaZliovnjVYQDOb1o0rM7Jueeytuv5C7JVu99EY1kx0v648OER3MWoZnHW9tnZYmFsZUaFRWtleXQbsO9TrnfRgrHbOaGUao9hJjbn7FyXUnVf_ji_O3RKP1o97rak0-neDU4PTeZ7dGv8HPsuHNzil6KXKUhqcgjweAjt5foPLMRWIzwofPWRaGDg4CRssO3nPYWOgjSSUCjU_jwRbTJAyF3EcqpCHEA8JVCWGNo8uneK9lME2Rm0Hif8OrD_d-goAAP__-yBvGQ) for the White House and making former President Trump the presumptive GOP nominee. Haley didn't endorse Trump and [challenged the former President ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7ojwgsEuKL4mXb72SgvMbrwX_CPAifL2p1x95Wia0XzdppvnxNv9v1_RVdonP1d-4qSEFaAn3UZHiICqRddZOQ4AnVTt4sJsqMce-ujHgLYb5yGgUuRhIGs707IDCVoqaTvZG-guoCh4ZbRVMWoldaMlRq57vnzvvNUFKb33J-bLvK9tckutR2nUvwauDVz9seGrfNQHcuU5YQPXjR8PFotP-BYZjzMknv0maj7XQ5TzwCzqiSX6t0h7KVjE2PvQm2AGPyBSCCQ10igJSEokGNvs4vHilLgY22h5Xz2n36T615-fAAAA__90QmeR)to win the support of her constituents. "Politics is about bringing people into your cause, not turning them away," she said. Shortly after her announcement, both [President Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOqzAQheGnsTsiM2MYKFzchi633RI5eBzPymAE3kR5-1VW2m7rT-cU_8d1vnrJst3_-5VdjWX2S5UHz9hQA3a2OrjIDIyaXUtmHABagzo5Dma0I9mBcIihpz7iQsNI0CENSzdocWDAGjTUmq6H9gIYbx57SxiCRWOVNRykluPyWWSriWN-lQcfl6WsOrtU634q_KdgUjDVxElyfpuCKZWVN36eCqbFr7uX-6Zgsl0LPWFzk8Bb8wtN8plfzfm17-WofLxH-nBhf0rOcvakrLmvXn6-df0rwncAAAD__3hZXIY) and Former President Trump made overtures toward Haley supporters. Biden applauded Haley for her "attacks" on Trump and welcomed her voters to his campaign. Trump said Biden's policies were destroying America and invited Haley's supporters "[to join the greatest movement](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL8GOjzoDtBTQfEadU6bUoPEyZCA0AC2x3-fcerUO7vFfl6Xq4spHrcPl8n2vSxu6_FBC4pRgFoU93YnAkJOdhjl9A9gkMiD1eAVTqTctMlBaWM8GI0rrujlOjnNowUJSqIcB6kNDBfAfXVo1IjeK5SKKUk-9lIvXyUePdCeXuVB9bKVzJMNvZ-N4X8GM4O5BwoxpTdjMIeS6aBnYzBvLp8u3g4Gs9IDGD2KXu_5FC253ERwiV6iEX030e7nWWqn-vZ4tf58xpRiMyNT8pZd_M3z_teHnwAAAP__7hReOw) in the history of our nation."
## Chinese National Arrested For Stealing Secrets
A former software engineer at Google has been charged with [stealing trade secrets](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFy6yAUhOGnQR0adMCSXai4jTrfNqWGwCKdDAIPEGv89hmnTr3Nt__Hfb1bjpy2__bA3EJerWv8xKrlJMmspvNzAAi6wzxM6nYlGpTu9lm5y-0ayDtrrfUeNF0RRgreBQQXfMczKTJKq2lQl5GGnnT4tHo0k_beaGWEUfDccum_Mqe2I8RXfqL0Lh9dnPfWHlXof4IWQct5nn3Bd0Op713Q0uD2lGPeXoKWkMuBIrectwiJtHECiuTk2TV4WRvs-6a0LCtcQavSspdu54QK6fLxsIlR5RstlZZqFLR0ZfaPk2PkOk7CqO2wHH997a9YPwEAAP__uoNuJQ) about artificial intelligence and funneling the information to two Chinese companies he secretly worked for. Linwei Ding, a Chinese national, was arrested Wednesday in Newark, California, and faces [four counts of theft of trade secrets](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyqzAQRb8GumWEJAMuKJ4LOr8qM0nHCGlB6wjJIylW_PcZ3KRJtcXZuXfOfb_OV0WO_PZf7TjmNcxKZ3rgLKAHLmdZm3FF5ChqHNuenQfOWyZqO0quNTdqHfSAvTQnxvQiunVYFuxO2J5rGjnjkgnWt-zU8bbhYl2U6GQvjJGCyUoyNJRDbG6BfLa4umd4YGx02Gs32pzvqRL_Kj5VfCqlNHvyB6v4hB6-UsUnj-U4GbX1wYXtebBv2ELYHEIKay4qIqDfyCNG0FbFDQ0UyhZSRnWogyL4TYBiySGUED8P9vrUljwmBB32u_KER6eKcLm0t_j2MdRxNPdCzlHq-kqybVfkXhb5r0l_AgAA__8AoHvz). A Google spokesperson said the company noticed documents were stolen, conducted an internal investigation, and contacted the FBI. Following the arrest, [Attorney General Merrick Garland ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGv4yAQhH8N7rDwLjFOQXENXa690sKw2HsiENlcrNyvf_KrXzOaYqRv9P15zA_Pmcv62z_JtlRnHxq_aUZpJOhZd9EmIiDsyA5G3SeAQWG3WUIMg8eAClK6xZtZ7pGWSYc06eQX07EFBVqhMoO6jTD0gGnxOGqDMWpUWmhFkVvd-7-VS9so5U99096H-uyy3Vp7HQJ_CXAC3Hme_b_Dtxr95xoIcEer-0eAK3QeAtyrZm4crnqBBTiFV4wCXKZaZOSyyrBxoYNk4Mb_qUjP8iI3GTa_rxQFOAPTeAc9KGUEuG638XVyznyMRmi1Pj3n74vtJ19fAQAA__8Bj2nA)said, "The Justice Department will not tolerate the theft of artificial intelligence and other advanced technologies that could put our national security at risk."
## Spring Break Ideas For the Late Planner
The spring break travel season is almost here, and if you're like The Editor and wait until the last minute to plan, you may want to check out [this list of trip ideas](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyszAQBOCnEZ0YcRLo_wsVaeicNiVzoMO-REaMdIbJ22ecpEy7-xU7-3aZLsiJt-sr3inImidchA-arPYa3OSaGFYiINtQ6Lz5_w-gM7a5BYTVoqdh8RD7uacebD_3HlfjPXqLDQcw4Iw1vjP9AF0Ldp3RDs7bGJ01TjlDkSWX9j3zJjda02c-qLRLvjcp3ET2quyLglHBeJ5nKwUPSrjFRFwfhZ5QwSiFd82RsCoY6154u-oDFxTO2zOaqYp-VP1bzYXwQ0eqwtuPaUqI-8kpcR28cuZ6R07fK-SvS74CAAD__5PgZSQ). For those who enjoy the coast, _Travel and Leisure_ recommends Destin, Florida, and Hilton Head, South Carolina. Both locations feature miles of Atlantic beach shoreline, water activities, and unique day trip options. If museums and attractions better suit your family, head over to Atlanta, where you'll find the World of Coca Cola and the largest Aquarium in the U.S. Our more [outdoor-oriented folks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyszAQBOCnEZ0YcRLo_wsVaeicNiVzoMO-REaMdIbJ22ecpEy7-xU7-3aZLsiJt-sr3inImidchA-arPYa3OSaGFYiINtQ6Lz5_w-gM7a5BYTVoqdh8RD7uacebD_3HlfjPXqLDQcw4Iw1vjP9AF0Ldp3RDs7bGJ01TjlDkSWX9j3zJjda02c-qLRLvjcp3ET2quyLglHBeJ5nKwUPSrjFRFwfhZ5QwSiFd82RsCoY6154u-oDFxTO2zOaqYp-VP1bzYXwQ0eqwtuPaUqI-8kpcR28cuZ6R07fK-SvS74CAAD__5PgZSQ) should check out Park City, Utah, and its excellent skiing, tubing, and ice skating.

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that's not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

**Sign up now using the secure link below, and we 'll send the Great Reset seminar lectures--absolutely free--directly to your inbox.**

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-great-reset-cca/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eac55db907634a99b78eee5614649f3b&_e=-xSrmGLDsYVlu555Fnyv73ufNyRSdxAkU2V3icSEmPee-T2cKGqDxwAwxoGzaS43s0VAzWSNtFj_e-nWkflbacoihyAif7WKdHHMouZZdI4YJv0LSnqxFrvqgMQMfOG9k44GL9PSY272sArdDVihnhjlppW6JWMQ9WudBMkWMSKBJ5QSf_NqXL9XU08fBiuJTaAL_Ptp5mH_-XH7Cv6bPfiPCJsvgtjeka55arRGk_AWlcZtzJNeGc-NTE1e3553RyLtBJaLh_ZtgGh1pkPjwuxweIsa9CJgO7vMwz-MRgbl68R9hmWoNx4TDOkQHlRF6fUDx5ruST9zalUEEWnDlJxA8QAG-otLpk_ufLs-E9zMlq8uWS5MEgkzShr9AxtYH1pW9vKXGjDhBl7CNWpbYQ%3D%3D)

Don't miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

Use the link above to receive your Great Reset video series today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f97acf0599f546edaacfc4fbf4aca8e1&_e=THzHhth4Raccg5qxvr3BsIW9GQyAxMZZbPrn6Zb6KZftuB-G0NlDoaIky0OQAYMPrvf3RDPMpgPRBBbjd8TwgR07CfQBoScsmw6IgoPeEd012q8CoV1mJyb1su545L2LIVC_WZbTKKJfZoVhslvETC7HC23rcmCBSkT28OL6KN5rLCwxkkubx7GMXQiLlShWc4WKSNOAByxMlD8_N6YTxcJH69UtPbwAy3xu2XsuKb3LUjp5lwp0EoHc15k3BtryxLD_jv1mrDl-9vXMoFC6kxQgyrnvs2Gpnx1e5rUlUp2wXaTqeExYsNbm8sG3oSum58oEPWXhgw7mdx1oheAbbCw4o95R4Ce_vFQ4NpgPzMbfC_KiGYzZ4XF2e5iH8hczURswoyOzRlAQ2WntSZe56w%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f97acf0599f546edaacfc4fbf4aca8e1&_e=THzHhth4Raccg5qxvr3BsIW9GQyAxMZZbPrn6Zb6KZftuB-G0NlDoaIky0OQAYMPrvf3RDPMpgPRBBbjd8TwgR07CfQBoScsmw6IgoPeEd012q8CoV1mJyb1su545L2LIVC_WZbTKKJfZoVhslvETC7HC23rcmCBSkT28OL6KN5rLCwxkkubx7GMXQiLlShWc4WKSNOAByxMlD8_N6YTxcJH69UtPbwAy3xu2XsuKb3LUjp5lwp0EoHc15k3BtryU_9kaYz7z0VKoMu6VMr_4OSmiN11FfXqW2-PyOm9peUMf5BCrXIAL73s9wgx0iaImlWz3m6oOJIWtOwff0r8lGLfEeHJvvrUxjK_Y-l7yivpzeDvQf4U4C1RDxIOnA60RGBqEzmbDHbj4y3QrTB1yQ%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f97acf0599f546edaacfc4fbf4aca8e1&_e=THzHhth4Raccg5qxvr3BsIW9GQyAxMZZbPrn6Zb6KZftuB-G0NlDoaIky0OQAYMPrvf3RDPMpgPRBBbjd8TwgR07CfQBoScsmw6IgoPeEd012q8CoV1mJyb1su545L2LIVC_WZbTKKJfZoVhslvETC7HC23rcmCBSkT28OL6KN5rLCwxkkubx7GMXQiLlShWc4WKSNOAByxMlD8_N6YTxcJH69UtPbwAy3xu2XsuKb3LUjp5lwp0EoHc15k3Btry5Ilut6C1jikUY39mTaQd2g84xdqsAfWXEMmsrUKwiRK63Z-Lx3nTUSTOkIRFeN2mDp2EOiu_c-OCmH1HSdvWA8JcP2J30ZhcKG2LRTmdKEGfT_U3oN9JrWilXqNYl7CCQLGySOIwU_3bumWsnKFTvA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12a0154ae36e4d46a5283a58da431fa9&_e=qh84l5yUUa_nJC0fwGDNcRertfR7FF1oelh79zUXEG829TcQADEF9U6MTqBpE3IssO31jN37Nmekpy67z2CbRPCAAmxbbBlqCoNhgXWdTGpLS7OGxK6OOXj4oN0WcE5JhEEdK-DEwXVvSjE8VWBElG1ROcmxE2P3A28hR4zK0o1cY37Up_lJH9uFcj-lKLSfERnBQvLv7J8gU7FTSTST-XziZuajqjNpCf9Zu0zYT0jpL2PKJava7rj8K6c3r9FWqGvODyM-QPv7Q9PpWAQBY4geLF5cG91q91OWOH7UhaVd0uhzHXDkItDE21PO43tv9uLBcaY7lyCa5x2w2k4tOf_DgoeafIm6K6G94ffU3gEU68eVH6Y8EItQJMN7uqMcpKesmfX-_nE2ocJO4lvFbA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12a0154ae36e4d46a5283a58da431fa9&_e=qh84l5yUUa_nJC0fwGDNcRertfR7FF1oelh79zUXEG829TcQADEF9U6MTqBpE3IssO31jN37Nmekpy67z2CbRPCAAmxbbBlqCoNhgXWdTGpLS7OGxK6OOXj4oN0WcE5JhEEdK-DEwXVvSjE8VWBElG1ROcmxE2P3A28hR4zK0o1cY37Up_lJH9uFcj-lKLSfERnBQvLv7J8gU7FTSTST-XziZuajqjNpCf9Zu0zYT0jpL2PKJava7rj8K6c3r9FWH_C3-GWeAlqgzDUYeF0YQja5E3XQAKQq_HkhR-h7vFSO5zyYwfIPuZy24y0GkqApKZikA6n4Dz_SmbD6DkABktwcWLKP2aFFICgpt32ZSm_VLEuro4aLP5c9C4yVVDzU9aaG6jLNrwOid3RUcbY6pg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12a0154ae36e4d46a5283a58da431fa9&_e=qh84l5yUUa_nJC0fwGDNcRertfR7FF1oelh79zUXEG829TcQADEF9U6MTqBpE3IssO31jN37Nmekpy67z2CbRPCAAmxbbBlqCoNhgXWdTGpLS7OGxK6OOXj4oN0WcE5JhEEdK-DEwXVvSjE8VWBElG1ROcmxE2P3A28hR4zK0o1cY37Up_lJH9uFcj-lKLSfERnBQvLv7J8gU7FTSTST-XziZuajqjNpCf9Zu0zYT0jpL2PKJava7rj8K6c3r9FWkYh9lI3Z4Ed2oRDdmf30-giTMgO-gpEVFbfCM4hcLSaqlYAP3C_q_FX7J_nYGkLZ8HqQHP0_LuRfuMCC4wqyp_AbImtGuGOxyYa_1d6IryIThXJZTgjrLBi4QgRZrh8uPjbUoArqV0kk-0RWgAGeeg%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=191e36fd37a6422bb40d257ed6b1bd96&_e=ZsT3Km1nrr5wL4BiixjdDoW2eN-wNXY9ODyF9xdFi_8Gw__fhoXPQnoarditpLugpeWgFz-IhGmYH7p_YQ5T-ard9qIs25xa6Zkc0uz9QF4GhZsVcGkdFkEwX8u3RhDnDLNbDWvGchkntyPUUgk78_0syoYDla5rox93hJmj_0dU1L48-hFPyhmrjRI8vv6hTpHTPRaGX3Fv1ymIP7x8W5dx5Xjv8aSpSPzhzWP9S-1MxES_P7T6qfkrDvumMIS3PbvHo2spvny5ugjNTYUODq9vVyLN4_mhH9vrlB8iwvXCdo5uBqhgW1zUl9VJKQQMSDSZo2Zkri_F8ZBiAQikC7dLVjBhYms51sn2fZcw5YqDyx9xKb3YbFfcjxQpNeTDtjGhVYSBI1Uhm8fSkAil9g%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=191e36fd37a6422bb40d257ed6b1bd96&_e=ZsT3Km1nrr5wL4BiixjdDoW2eN-wNXY9ODyF9xdFi_8Gw__fhoXPQnoarditpLugpeWgFz-IhGmYH7p_YQ5T-ard9qIs25xa6Zkc0uz9QF4GhZsVcGkdFkEwX8u3RhDnDLNbDWvGchkntyPUUgk78_0syoYDla5rox93hJmj_0dU1L48-hFPyhmrjRI8vv6hTpHTPRaGX3Fv1ymIP7x8W5dx5Xjv8aSpSPzhzWP9S-1MxES_P7T6qfkrDvumMIS3H6rqpVobiwN6Hj-g33L97ArNfWsvOr5kjRWud2rRD51pcu3tKIaK-crIhZiSpxDJuUjK_EpWE5-QxJn4nRAOy5_Ez4gX9adjJN1y38zsYRzkF1S5GVGR5zKyjkzRy5G0hHT4Ww5b8HMcolHuQ5du0g%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=191e36fd37a6422bb40d257ed6b1bd96&_e=ZsT3Km1nrr5wL4BiixjdDoW2eN-wNXY9ODyF9xdFi_8Gw__fhoXPQnoarditpLugpeWgFz-IhGmYH7p_YQ5T-ard9qIs25xa6Zkc0uz9QF4GhZsVcGkdFkEwX8u3RhDnDLNbDWvGchkntyPUUgk78_0syoYDla5rox93hJmj_0dU1L48-hFPyhmrjRI8vv6hTpHTPRaGX3Fv1ymIP7x8W5dx5Xjv8aSpSPzhzWP9S-1MxES_P7T6qfkrDvumMIS3HxwX6GWdmoqAsQmv7h_0K4YPDr6ZZ1lfk2GJI67mzahAsaQLpwc04lER73D_XXFjP91P0vIkOpauo4yNhtDco6NoNaeGeolHY4FHXaGM-hcvnj9xyn4jUI_n2gb3kyvkZXExqXwZTQ3XmFjhOyiiSQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| | | Folks - this is John Kennedy.

**It kills me to say this but some of these emails are about as useful as a screen door on a submarine.**

Maybe it’s a few Big Tech overlords sending our emails to spam...

Maybe it’s the crazies calling good folks like you traitors for ignoring them...

Maybe it’s that most of you are a little tired of politics...

And on the last point, that’s OK. I completely understand. But I want to explain where I’m coming from: You see, my Conservative friends over in the House have a HUGE deadline closing in, and I just got word they’re pacing DANGEROUSLY behind their goal.

Dear Peter,
I agree with the 9-0 Supreme Court decision allowing former President Trump to appear on the ballot in 2024.
The Court rightly decided that it is wrong for individual states to attempt to remove Trump over and above the will of the people.
In a democracy, it is the voters who are supposed to decide who takes office.
In authoritarian countries, voters only get to choose from a roster of government-approved candidates.
**We must not let America move further in that direction.**
* * *
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=takedown_averted_3_7_24_u_nd3&n=5)
If the Democrats don’t like Trump, and we know they don't—then beat him at the ballot box.
With your ongoing help, that is exactly what we will do. We will beat both President Trump and President Biden at the ballot box on Election Day.
**To do that, we have to get onto the ballot in every state.**
The two parties’ candidates are on the ballot automatically. Not me. _We have to muster a 50-state ground game to be listed._
And we will face the same sort of legal shenanigans that Trump faces in an effort to remove me from the ballot.
But we are overcoming every obstacle as our campaign quickly gains momentum—something the entrenched Political Establishment fears will disrupt their status quo.
