disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dean 24
body:
Dean Phillips for President 2024 [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/103532/images/logo_color.png]
Hi Friend,
Just one year ago, the thought of running for President hadn’t crossed my mind. I was focused on raising the alarm about President Biden’s eroding support and encouraging the best positioned Democrats to enter the race to defeat Donald Trump.
Little did I know that none would heed that call and that by the end of October we would be taking a bold leap together. And together, we embarked on a mission of principle fueled by the conviction that democracy dies without competition.
I want to personally thank you — every single person who donated, volunteered, attended an event, promoted me on social media, or told a friend to vote. This was an unprecedented mission for an unprecedented moment and I couldn’t be more grateful for your support. It was an honor and privilege to have represented you during this campaign.
However, after assessing Tuesday’s election results, resourcing needs, and polling data, I made the decision to suspend my campaign and endorse President Biden - behind whom we must coalesce to protect our country and ensure decency and integrity remain in the White House. For my part, I’ll continue to make sure everyone’s invited.
While it is the end of this campaign, it also marks the beginning of another. Important and existential work awaits all who aspire to the restoration of the American brand, the redistribution of opportunity, the reinvigoration of participation, and the revitalization of optimism. So please stay tuned for steps we can take together to ensure a promising future for the American Dream and democracy.
Keep in touch, keep the faith, and keep believing that anything is possible.
Dean

name: Marco Rubio
subject: A roll of aluminum foil
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rubio Victory Committee
body:
I can’t explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it – there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don't think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.
---
| | [DONATE $1](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi95i064e7095cjc1prlnrgf0bdimj3kinimqmho_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3j62ob0cjh2bs "DONATE $1")
---
| | [DONATE WHATEVER YOU CAN](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zrd2lrm5sj2oc1je2junc16trf1vc88nc3pm7o88_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3j62ob0cjh2bs "DONATE WHATEVER YOU CAN")
---
Growing up, my mom worked at a factory that made aluminum chairs and my father was a bartender. Their wages combined with their hard work allowed for them to buy a home and live in a good community.

**I 'm trying to restore America to the time when it wasn't unusual that a factory worker and a bartender could afford a home. I'd appreciate it if you could go above and beyond and donate the price of a roll of aluminum foil! [Democrats rely on billionaire megadonors who give thousands at a time. I rely on folks like you, who can give $3, $9, or even $18.25 to reach my goals.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgmposq2cabmm8l21030o7gai9q8o2poqmg71b58_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3j62ob0cjh2bs "Democrats rely on billionaire megadonors who give thousands at a time. I rely on folks like you, who can give $3, $9, or even $18.25 to reach my goals.")**
---
| | [CHIP IN THE PRICE OF ALUMINUM FOIL](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1e7esdvnhkogqt9vf0m7tnb62c0rmsl7kue93u8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3j62ob0cjh2bs "CHIP IN THE PRICE OF ALUMINUM FOIL")
---
_Democrats hope I give up on you and stop sending these emails.

They also hope you stop reading these emails.

They'd love it if we both give up on our conservative values altogether._

_**I won 't give up on you, and I hope you won't quit on me or our shared values either.**_ I know a lot of folks are going to ignore this, but I need patriots like you to see what's at stake. If you think you're better off than you were 5 years ago, then I understand why you don't want to donate today.

But if you think we need to get this country back on track and restore the American Dream, please donate whatever you can before midnight.

| | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Pennsylvania Project
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/b21dc53d3ee0/we-need-your-help-to-do-big-things-in-13664916?e=95417d7e87)
Logo

Good morning Friend Unknown

Happy Women’s History Month! We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well.

Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, recent events, and other resources as we head towards the April primary and November general elections.

** Courts Corner #CourtsMatter
------------------------------------------------------------

Supreme Court to hear arguments in Trump immunity case in April (https://www.npr.org/2024/02/28/1231974416/supreme-court-trump-immunity)
* Three judges on the federal appeals court in Washington, D.C., unanimously sided with prosecutors this month."We cannot accept that the office of the Presidency places its former occupants above the law for all time thereafter," the U.S. circuit judges wrote. Doing so, they said, "would collapse our system of separated powers by placing the President beyond the reach of all three branches," NPR reports. (https://www.npr.org/2024/02/28/1231974416/supreme-court-trump-immunity)

Racial disparities in voter turnout have grown since Supreme Court ruling, study says (https://www.npr.org/2024/03/05/1235521824/voter-turnout-race-disparities-supreme-court)
* The turnout gap between white and nonwhite voters in the U.S. is growing fastest in jurisdictions that were stripped of a federal civil rights-era voting protection a decade ago, according to a new study, NPR reports. (https://www.npr.org/2024/03/05/1235521824/voter-turnout-race-disparities-supreme-court)

GOP backs voting by mail, yet turns to courts to restrict it in battleground states (https://tennesseelookout.com/2024/03/04/gop-backs-voting-by-mail-yet-turns-to-courts-to-restrict-it-in-battleground-states/)
* Fearing that Democrats hold a crucial edge in ballots cast before Election Day, national Republicans are working to convince their voters to take advantage of mail and early voting this year, Tennessee Lookout reports (https://tennesseelookout.com/2024/03/04/gop-backs-voting-by-mail-yet-turns-to-courts-to-restrict-it-in-battleground-states/) .

Pennsylvania court rules electronic voting data is not subject to release under public records law (https://apnews.com/article/pennsylvania-elections-voting-court-electronic-9b83f4009996245673c4c343ed3a7484?oref=cspa_firstread_nl&utm_source=Sailthru&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=First%20Read%20PA%20-%20March%205%2C%202024&utm_term=newsletter_cspa_firstread)
* Spreadsheets of raw data associated with every ballot cast are not subject to public scrutiny, a Pennsylvania court ruled yesterday in a case that began with a request for the “cast vote records” by an election researcher, The Associated Press reports. (https://apnews.com/article/pennsylvania-elections-voting-court-electronic-9b83f4009996245673c4c343ed3a7484?oref=cspa_firstread_nl&utm_source=Sailthru&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=First%20Read%20PA%20-%20March%205%2C%202024&utm_term=newsletter_cspa_firstread)

** Social of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------

Congratulations to New Pennsylvania Project & New PA Project Education Fund’s own Kadida Kenner for making the City & State PA 2024 Black Trailblazers List! Check out the full list here (https://www.cityandstatepa.com/power-lists/2024/02/2024-black-trailblazers/394377/?oref=ng-homepage-top-story) . #ExpandTheElectorate
https://www.facebook.com/NewPennsylvaniaProject https://www.instagram.com/newpennsylvania https://twitter.com/NewPennsylvania

** News You Can Use
------------------------------------------------------------

Billboards blaming Trump for Alabama’s IVF ruling are going up in Philadelphia (https://www.inquirer.com/politics/donald-trump-billboards-in-vitro-fertilization-20240227.html)
* Billboards slamming former President Donald Trump over a recent Alabama State Supreme Court ruling, which has threatened access to in-vitro fertilization, are going up in battleground states — including Pennsylvania. The Democratic National Committee is paying for billboards in the Philadelphia area, Harrisburg, and Pittsburgh, as part of a national campaign that seeks to connect Trump’s role in the overturning of Roe v. Wade to the state court ruling last week that held that embryos have the same legal protections as children,” Philadelphia Inquirer reports. (https://www.inquirer.com/politics/donald-trump-billboards-in-vitro-fertilization-20240227.html)

U.S. Supreme Court strikes down Colorado 14th Amendment ruling, clearing Trump for ballot (https://penncapital-star.com/uncategorized/u-s-supreme-court-strikes-down-colorado-14th-amendment-ruling-clearing-trump-for-ballot/?oref=cspa_firstread_nl&utm_source=Sailthru&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=First%20Read%20PA%20-%20March%205%2C%202024&utm_term=newsletter_cspa_firstread)
* Former President Donald Trump must be placed on Colorado’s 2024 ballot, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled unanimously yesterday, striking down a holding by the Colorado Supreme Court, The Capital-Star reports. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I have an opponent
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
It’s official, team: John Deaton, a well-funded Republican, has launched a campaign to run against me for Senate in Massachusetts.
Apparently, the MAGA Republican machine couldn’t find a single Republican in Massachusetts to run against me — so they brought in someone from Rhode Island who will have the backing of the GOP and special interest groups.
This much is clear: We’re up against national Republicans who are desperate to take back the Senate and pass Trump’s agenda. We’re up against their rich buddies who are trying to stop us from taxing the wealthy, regulating big banks, and making our government work for working people.
It’s going to take a strong grassroots movement to compete and win. Can you please split a donation of $20 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Seth Moulton? We need to respond to my opponent’s campaign launch with the strongest amount of grassroots donations to protect our Senate majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-warren]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-warren]
I’m proud of the progress we’ve accomplished for Massachusetts families so far — like lowering the cost of hearing aids, passing a new tax on massive corporations that were paying $0 in taxes, getting student loan debt canceled, securing billions in funding for projects like an electric bus fleet and infrastructure repairs, and so much more.
But there’s plenty more to do for working people in Massachusetts and across the country. We’ve got to bring down the cost of housing. Put child care within reach for all working parents. Protect our Commonwealth from the climate crisis. Take power away from powerful interests like Big Pharma, Big Oil, and big banks and put it in the hands of working people — which means we need to root corruption out of Washington. And I’ve got the most sweeping set of anti-corruption plans since Watergate.
This election is about who our government works for — and it’s about defending our democracy and our basic freedoms. I’m fighting to keep our Senate majority because if Republicans win any more power, they’ll restrict abortion access everywhere, even in blue states that have passed abortion protections — like Massachusetts. They’ll threaten voting rights, LGBTQIA+ rights, Social Security, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act — they’ll reward the rich and powerful, and embolden an extremist base across the country.
So I’m staying in this fight to stop MAGA extremism, continue standing up to powerful special interests, and make real change for working people. Are you with me?
Please respond to my opponent’s announcement today with a donation of $20 or anything you can to support this campaign and Seth Moulton. Grassroots supporters like you have helped defeat the GOP and special interests in the past, and I need your support again as we take on this new fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-warren]
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

body:
#
Derek,
From Day One, we have built this team around the motto Every County, Every Vote.
It’s why we drove to communities big and small across PA in 2021 and 2022, beating the odds to flip Pennsylvania blue and defend the Senate.

------------------------------------------------------------

In my new ad (https://fb.watch/qEptq7gvLe/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=3c5424ebb7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_04_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-3c5424ebb7-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , I make a solemn pledge to stand by those struggling with addiction and to hold drug dealers accountable for their heinous crimes.

It's a message that demands attention, especially considering the staggering statistics: more than 480,000 Americans have lost their lives to fentanyl, surpassing the death toll of World War II.

I also share my personal connection to this issue,
recounting the story of family members who have battled addiction. It's a deeply personal journey that has only strengthened my resolve to make a difference.

As I've said before, "Indiana’s economy cannot reach its full potential if our workers are suffering from mental health and addiction issues."

As governor, I will enhance the state’s mental health services and partner with non-profits to help our most vulnerable citizens.

| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson--I'm writing to you personally because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the unborn. **And today I need your help.**

I know you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1e92c9b1b3334de4a3cf74a509563e17&_e=mHUUEV2j4ZqxkkmnQ4O5PiHBTuVLpD2JpAO4cB0VXXRdN3Esaz7XOALsNbwm7ZpRR0VmMGtot_Txsv98lxrmw4wLOHIuFzUZy5qQEeQFcW9e0aJ4V0geSFsYRwESsdd948lj8h6GEpf3aiSpEe05ViNRblQJPBv1cnCNN6MaBonXVK_HQ7K2STHzQv49w_Hc-RkdE3krRu5dE2yS59G6LCDCneWFl82gSx4PkWKdzf5FPCIvsqW5JZyaxS8Rnb4gyXOsZcf3O_s2OqLYKlT2DPLAxGxk0YHMpON2czmAmfBAA2GnP3ZmqZDA1HX_acBAR5b3trP52SFoHbUePFvpfHmP8Qw1RGh2k9bae5KpKkOdC6lHAXIYtVENpg43SrT-RhcZOyopiOmwFGyAln72xKV88DmlySKvrjcXqyxVmtY%3D) **Nothing could be further from the truth --**[the fight for life is only just beginning!](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1e92c9b1b3334de4a3cf74a509563e17&_e=mHUUEV2j4ZqxkkmnQ4O5PiHBTuVLpD2JpAO4cB0VXXRdN3Esaz7XOALsNbwm7ZpRR0VmMGtot_Txsv98lxrmw4wLOHIuFzUZy5qQEeQFcW9e0aJ4V0geSFsYRwESsdd948lj8h6GEpf3aiSpEe05ViNRblQJPBv1cnCNN6MaBonXVK_HQ7K2STHzQv49w_Hc-RkdE3krRu5dE2yS59G6LCDCneWFl82gSx4PkWKdzf5FPCIvsqW5JZyaxS8Rnb4gpsa8R2Wi589a_lcFe3gF1qZCbK7nIWAlral1pWlUp_SnGbKrNejJEj_IvkzWJnB-43kUmpvmMWwwjKIbMWu1lWM9E4cJ6-CnfreNsmcrVqONKQYvl_0rLFCkIpq14AIM2IZpunThjqsyNqNsmxJ2HAu4YCTAwQ5CRfLfbOrlMsg%3D)

Right now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice democrats and major media outlets to codify abortion-on-demand at the expense of taxpayers like you.

**We cannot allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that abortion should be unrestricted.**

We must stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of the American family.

**Today, I 'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to the pledge I have linked below:**

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1e92c9b1b3334de4a3cf74a509563e17&_e=mHUUEV2j4ZqxkkmnQ4O5PiHBTuVLpD2JpAO4cB0VXXRdN3Esaz7XOALsNbwm7ZpRR0VmMGtot_Txsv98lxrmw4wLOHIuFzUZy5qQEeQFcW9e0aJ4V0geSFsYRwESsdd948lj8h6GEpf3aiSpEe05ViNRblQJPBv1cnCNN6MaBonXVK_HQ7K2STHzQv49w_Hc-RkdE3krRu5dE2yS59G6LCDCneWFl82gSx4PkWKdzf5FPCIvsqW5JZyaxS8Rnb4g8Imp5VeAJYA1Mv4h3_VKq9da4ePJWzVhtWEkKE41Ig8RKqVfyJRjMMWBLqfaLXpjqcMBGBaNgdgrK9RR04KcqZdepBp6BnY-adKrGZYqies4Tsaq0xY30_Pfcuz-C3ni66Odhf37kS5q1ElxRP0ZaK_V0FMEU3_XBpPRYqdy0vE%3D)

By signing the pledge, you will join a thriving movement of principled citizens who are uniting to protect the unborn and refusing to be silenced by a vocal minority of radicalized fanatics.

I will do everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the spread of the Left's anti-life ideology. [**Will you take a minute to stand with me by signing this pledge now?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1e92c9b1b3334de4a3cf74a509563e17&_e=mHUUEV2j4ZqxkkmnQ4O5PiHBTuVLpD2JpAO4cB0VXXRdN3Esaz7XOALsNbwm7ZpRR0VmMGtot_Txsv98lxrmw4wLOHIuFzUZy5qQEeQFcW9e0aJ4V0geSFsYRwESsdd948lj8h6GEpf3aiSpEe05ViNRblQJPBv1cnCNN6MaBonXVK_HQ7K2STHzQv49w_Hc-RkdE3krRu5dE2yS59G6LCDCneWFl82gSx4PkWKdzf5FPCIvsqW5JZyaxS8Rnb4ggVRD-qKK_ruHABS7uFZvcG5Sb_on3g9GvjQDCrpSzpz_cWst1LzJ5X4M9zi-n4upMYcSWO9LbRkHue9NrX6hOeVhHx20s-GgqVxSLRAbBVCME_e8NgyIrwiVtWRgunV15CC4AUhNYz9Y0D5NoytrB1ZmQtgraiQIIyeO7udhmHI%3D)

I'd like to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can save thousands of lives from abortion over the next year.

Gratefully,
Dr. Ben Carson

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| It wasn’t easy, but I thought you should know about this.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2180%2E35263%2EvLSk0l)
Hi team — It’s Scott, Tammy’s campaign manager. I made a difficult decision yesterday, and I thought you should know about it. As you may know, Republican megamillionaire Eric Hovde recently announced his Senate campaign to flip Tammy’s seat red. And in just one week, **our opponent flooded $2.5 million into Wisconsin to go up with self-funded TV and digital ads — several weeks before our campaign planned to launch ads of our own.** Look, whoever has more resources to spend on TV will likely win this election. That means we can't let Hovde and his right-wing allies control the narrative. We need to make sure voters know the truth now. After talking it through with Tammy and the team, we decided to increase our March advertising budget to go up with our own ads as soon as possible. The money wasn’t in the budget, but I gave the green light anyway. I took a big risk here. There’s no doubt about it. But I was willing to bet that if I reached out and told the truth, our grassroots supporters would come through to help fill this unexpected hole in our budget. That’s the only way we can keep pace with the $20 million Hovde plans to spend. **[So, can I count on you to pitch in to Tammy’s reelection campaign today? I need you to hear this, friend: Donald Trump is the GOP nominee for president again.
This is a man who incited an insurrection and threatens the very fabric of our democracy. Who boasts about overturning Roe v. Wade and taking away women’s reproductive freedoms. Who — a few weeks ago — said that he _wants_ to see the U.S. economy fail, because it would help his presidential campaign. **And he’s neck-and-neck with President Biden in the latest polls.**
So when you hear people say that 2024 will be the “most consequential election of our lifetimes,” that’s not hyperbole.
**[_We need to do everything we can — right now — to ensure that we reelect President Biden and save our Democratic Senate majority._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80489826/459500236/-1220293910?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4881-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzYwOTRkYS05NmRjLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IpPnm2u_mM5jkfugE6sp0YCKQ1xezo6RuaxptYFDdwY=)**
That means getting the message out about the ways in which President Biden and Senate Democrats have delivered for the American people:
* Capping the price of insulin and lowering prescription drug costs for seniors;
* Finally enacting a gun trafficking ban and passing transformative gun safety legislation;
* Protecting Social Security;
* And investing billions to rebuild our roads, bridges, tunnels and sewer systems — creating good-paying, union jobs at the same time.

Make no mistake: Democrats have a winning message. **But we have to make sure that our message of results and progress can cut through the noise of far-right lies and attacks up and down the ballot. **[**So I'm personally asking you to split a donation of $5, or whatever you can spare today, between President Biden's reelection campaign and mine. Please, will you donate now to help us defend the White House _and_ the Senate this November?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80489827/459500237/-1220293910?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4881-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzYwOTRkYS05NmRjLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IpPnm2u_mM5jkfugE6sp0YCKQ1xezo6RuaxptYFDdwY=)

As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. | | | | | Peter, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect. One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors. And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her. I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign. [**Please, split a $5 or $10 donation between Blue Amp Action and my campaign. Whatever you can afford can help us build the team that’s going to win in Arizona. BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U
body:

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWODcefiN1

Dear
Fellow Patriot,
If you
opened this email because you remember my playing days with the
Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having
you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey
Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we
battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...
...well,
as they say, "Those were the days."
But this
email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's a email I never thought
I'd be writing to you.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a
seat in the United States Senate.
As of
March 5th, it's official. I'm going head-to-head with Adam Schiff
in November.
Democrat
policies have brought America to its knees.
There's
fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime,
homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding
and for the first time causing more people to leave California.
Joe
Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one
bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to
say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and
dependent.
And
that's why I'm running for Senate.
We
Republicans pulled our country out of the 1970's Democratic
malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.
And I
believe we can do it again by putting classic conservative values
at the heart of everything we do.
But there
is no way I can pull it off without you.
Will you
rush a contribution to my campaign of $35 or more today?
I've
lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell
you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never
seen before.
They are
hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters
in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of
California...
I know we
can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.
I'm
fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake
-- I'm not just taking the field for Californians.
When we
win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical
Adam Schiff...
...we
start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country
desperately needs.
Thank you
and God Bless,

Steve
Garvey

Republican for United States Senate

DONATE

BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE

Angeles, CA 90053-2389

body:
Judicial Watch’s investigations and litigation continue without a break...

| Dear Fellow American,

So many things have been happening recently that I wanted to be sure you had a chance to read the email below...

Because since I first sent this email to you, the U.S. Supreme Court agreed with our _“friend of the court”_ brief and struck down the Colorado Supreme Court decision to bar Donald Trump from the state’s presidential primary ballot; we have also sued **Mississippi** over its law extending Election Day by five business days; and we have filed _new lawsuits_ in **California** and **Massachusetts** over “reverse racism” programs!

We are making a big impact on multiple fronts...[please help us with a special contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67354&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)!

Thank you, as always, for your past support of Judicial Watch.

Thank you,

Tom Fitton
President
Judicial Watch

* * *

**From:** Tom Fitton
**Date:** Thursday, Feb 1, 2024 at 9:14 AM
**Subject:** : Never More Important....

**I simply cannot overstate this ...**
Your support has _never been more important than it is today!_
**Because right now we are carrying the largest and most important caseload in our 30-year history ...and making a major impact for the rule of law!**
**[And that's why I ask you to make a contribution today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67354&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67354&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

Here's why we need your help now.

**_We continue to fight for honest elections_ ... **

name: General Flynn
subject: A New Nuclear-Level Threat Has Emerged –
body:
How Do We Counter It?

| | | |
## A New Nuclear-Level Threat Has Emerged –

## How Do We Counter It?

---
## _By: Michael T Flynn_

The landscape of warfare has evolved significantly over the past century.
As conflicts shift from armies and soldiers on physical battlefields to the digital realm focused on the civilian populace within a target nation, AI-driven psychological programming has emerged as a potent weapon with the potential to inflict lasting damage on a nation, akin to the devastating effects of a nuclear bomb.
In the context of fifth-generation warfare, where the focus lies on manipulating public opinion, exploiting societal vulnerabilities, causing internal strife in a target nation, shaping public perception, and influencing the belief systems of children and the perceptions of individuals within institutions and agencies, psychological programming becomes a critical component in this new era of digital-based psychological warfare.
As artificial intelligence continues to revolutionize industries and transform the way we communicate, work and live, the national security threats and ethical concerns associated with its misuse grow as well.
Foreign-born AI-driven psychological programming refers to the use of AI technologies by our foreign adversaries, such as the Chinese Communist Party, to manipulate, influence or control the thoughts, emotions and behaviors of individuals or groups of Americans. While this can sound like science fiction, it’s not and now we sit at a precipice attempting to get past our individual cognitive dissonance and face the threat.
We are short on time because this bomb has already detonated, and bigger threats are getting closer. This type of programming is being employed to undermine our way of life, manipulate public opinion, incite fear or hatred of each other, and even control political outcomes. It’s the silent and unseen tool that amplifies polarization and division within our society.
Given the increasing sophistication of AI technologies, it is crucial for the U.S. to establish comprehensive legislation to protect its citizens from harm caused by foreign-born AI-driven psychological programming.
Like a nuclear bomb, the impact of unchecked foreign-born AI-driven psychological programming is a devastating blow to American society; it’s far-reaching and deeply destructive. Both weapons can dismantle the very fabric of society, albeit through different means.
A nuclear bomb causes widespread physical destruction, while AI-driven psychological programming erodes trust, destroys families, fuels division and manipulates the public’s thoughts and actions to accept an unwanted new normal. The insidious nature of psychological programming may make it harder to detect, but the cumulative effects can be just as damaging to a nation’s social cohesion and stability.
One of the key similarities between a nuclear bomb and AI-driven psychological programming is their long-lasting impact.
In the case of a nuclear attack, the fallout includes radiation contamination, long-term health consequences and environmental damage. With AI-driven psychological programming, the fallout is subtler, invisible to most of the senses but equally persistent with long-lasting damage: the erosion of trust in institutions, the amplification of social divisions, and the manipulation of public opinion for the strategic gain of our adversaries.
Often, these effects cause the destruction of a nation from within. Either way, both are used to destroy a nation, and both are weapons that deserve our immediate attention.
This is the most effective weapon of the digital age. Fifth-generation warfare emphasizes non-physical dimensions, such as cyber and information warfare, to achieve strategic objectives. In this context, AI-driven psychological programming becomes the perfect weapon. It allows foreign actors to infiltrate the target nation’s digital sphere and exploit its vulnerabilities to achieve their goals.
By manipulating social media, spreading disinformation and employing micro-targeting techniques, adversaries can subtly shape public discourse and opinion without ever setting foot on the battlefield.
Have you wondered why everything seems so crazy, and it’s everywhere? Riots and cultural changes within institutions and agencies including the Department of Defense have all occurred through weaponized AI leveraged by foreign powers.
Another form of AI-driven psychological programming is the use of micro-targeted algorithms to personalize propaganda.
Social media and other platforms use AI algorithms to determine which content is displayed to an individual based on his online activity, behavior, vulnerabilities and associations. This can be used to influence an individual’s beliefs and attitudes by exposing them to only certain types of content and suppressing others.
Foreign entities use this method to spread false information or propaganda, cause anxiety and radicalization, or to manipulate public opinion. All of this is amplified by geo-tracking through cellphones and data collection.
Attributing responsibility for an AI-driven psychological attack is far more challenging than identifying the source of a nuclear bomb. The use of AI-powered deceptive techniques can obscure the origin of the attack, making it difficult to hold the responsible parties accountable. This anonymity enables aggressors to continue their campaigns with relative impunity.
Given the increasing sophistication of AI technologies and the potential harm caused by foreign-born AI-driven psychological programming, it is crucial for the U.S. to establish comprehensive legislation to protect its citizens from these threats with regulation that stops our adversaries but allows us to develop and deploy AI technologies that enrich our society.
Foreign-born AI-driven psychological programming has emerged as a formidable weapon in the arsenal of fifth-generation warfare. It wreaks havoc on the social, political and psychological fabric of our nation. Although the methods of attack differ, the devastation caused by foreign-born AI-driven psychological programming causes lasting damage to a nation’s core.
As we navigate this new era of digital-based psychological warfare, it is crucial to recognize the gravity of the threat and devise strategies to counter and mitigate the impact of foreign-born AI-driven psychological programming. The first steps are awareness of the situation and comprehensive legislation to protect American citizens from these nuclear-level threats.
By staying vigilant and proactive, we can preserve our way of life, social cohesion and the values we hold dear in the face of this new and insidious threat to our nation.

Friend,

I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy.

Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship.

But my parents didn't buy into any of that.

I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted.

Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department.

All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him.

But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed.

My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever.

By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns.

From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family.

We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am.

My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight.

**Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons:

1\. To pray to God
2\. To get to work**

So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work.

And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since.

>From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done.

My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission.

**[Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=36e488676d8b423bb6ef4b9e40ad510e&_e=1TWx7R5TJBJrIgtVPm4UWtHeSKok4QjOwZStVpwEp209A9wjMTQIRfkniEUVL50p7iWBc0XBLMzoPnvXdZsnW3D_jNMkJ5OBCxvtulTQ9ol1x2E3MGhFo-R2QDikxr_EJGiIHevoDJsHaZhpbJzaiU-26AExjQ7xG2lwNoddGSxgOnrXs1YrS5qzyCrbY6s3Cu_EyPIWapfYSOMrhgju7pro6KiyUr7NjPx7ab7O5EJpcOtJo-KZPSsOelHxOWtl5ZbSYBzmhJC7oKKvk6JfJMWkqVtC8lx8AHAyvGxZEi7htlaN8TxLhOiETrjL8qNNP9O9r-jPJnPa-CX0Vbj2N9cERzKIQX_yRegKrVrA4hocs_tuwE1PyXzZX8sMeiFpVN6OoqqYYcqxsGQREqzRjj52-0AoElB75Nfk4vV2wb3OI8A4nJX-5pWLSUF-jgFf2lrskf6afZxUe7JiQqezipdACZn1ifVpupA3_b6b7F1ow8301TBoCoQK7NMPYp5OPsbxfFEtM5_jTMC6_0R7TQ%3D%3D "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. ")**

And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of.

That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way.

I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups.

The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me.

Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God.

**[So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight?](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=36e488676d8b423bb6ef4b9e40ad510e&_e=1TWx7R5TJBJrIgtVPm4UWtHeSKok4QjOwZStVpwEp209A9wjMTQIRfkniEUVL50p7iWBc0XBLMzoPnvXdZsnW3D_jNMkJ5OBCxvtulTQ9ol1x2E3MGhFo-R2QDikxr_EJGiIHevoDJsHaZhpbJzaiU-26AExjQ7xG2lwNoddGSxgOnrXs1YrS5qzyCrbY6s3Cu_EyPIWapfYSOMrhgju7pro6KiyUr7NjPx7ab7O5EJpcOtJo-KZPSsOelHxOWtl5ZbSYBzmhJC7oKKvk6JfJMWkqVtC8lx8AHAyvGxZEi7htlaN8TxLhOiETrjL8qNNP9O9r-jPJnPa-CX0Vbj2N9cERzKIQX_yRegKrVrA4hocs_tuwE1PyXzZX8sMeiFpeHt-cTE3ArCUao34eC7AECyAuC6S-Kb-afjHOuhVkFq_9-uBosKWrPZq6UWk9Imrs65GqFv900G-AG9EN-6qGqvi0CpZf-agw7MTcaWtmWYc67MAxkqAbCWr52dVszk8MZ9jOSfjpj5f5XDDOVxjCA%3D%3D "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? | | Peter, I think about this Ronald Reagan quote a lot:
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=1d192f1a19c44a14a16b334cb42f8798&_e=-XeTqrhU_o9RLV1iTAx2EbAsthSgYe1vmAQrzQ29v8WXSc74qZajV21TvP6ioxyJ1TVKRZVnVVdkPLMdtkd63FY62v6EnmxqRrT_e8YsEmDDfhfCGpryEYj9kkephqBHh2ZtQVLIEquUNjrD-FXu7NgX_ARbrnxRwCaH82Rq6P7yUtuKX4Wwt_cIXWi5JX9YVxe5TDokNqjxjs_4_lhk61tsHJtlibl-tFahkuTZ_yb1Zur0TWNnmo8kv2a_jgpWtatEXfGDE2oj3j8QQ6Gh4Tio4LqTeo67vYWFrOHYtzg6uK8-3S00MT6HmllvX_OYISgEKzjzZ09g6JWoaMdtoywn_O3xQtX-0T_fYTzAx1o%3D) **_“You can live in Germany, Turkey, or Japan, but you can't become a German, a Turk, or a Japanese. But anyone, from any corner of the earth, can come live in America and become an American”_**

America is the greatest country in the world, and I truly believe that.

I came here with little besides the clothes on my back with my family when I was just four years old.

My family had no flag to stand under and no place to call our home. We had just escaped communist Vietnam, and if it wasn’t for this country’s opportunities, we may not be alive.

**My family did everything we could to learn the ways of this strange new country, and before we knew it, we were truly Americans.**

I love America so much, and that’s why at just 18 years old, I decided to spend my life serving her.

I was appointed to the U.S. Naval Academy, and I spent the next 25 years in the Navy fighting on the front lines, retiring as a Captain.

**Now, I’m ready to embark on my next mission: serving our country as a U.S. Senator.**

**[**Will you help me get to the U.S. Capitol to continue my service to our country?**](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=1d192f1a19c44a14a16b334cb42f8798&_e=-XeTqrhU_o9RLV1iTAx2EbAsthSgYe1vmAQrzQ29v8WXSc74qZajV21TvP6ioxyJ0kZ6BvbR7UUO-3paVb8S1CiWP56HRuuqwHMB4Qab6sjIypznH3M_AAJZzIXFDRg_DrETGAEnY20_H6GgWJx_nUo1u27NpMvHyWN7X5q9ubLlpuF880r09eYvkiAKacaU3akibG9u0fGiHIU_MMvYccbp9ZGDbgMjHrB-2aHI79iOL9EZy1KFhBuESi8tsQF6L4JqF53rmLrty-AeOKcdBOX3CZu8QxpHpR5LLXxGOP6FnadS1TrqHzUBWJuZMax_FmjCfcyNFYiS0HwMBFqaqrpjRXvzxFlDhyI4nh1Che5L5PTIm3Jz-vn_7sF1qbW2)**

---
[**SEND A VETERAN TO THE U.S. SENATE >>**](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=1d192f1a19c44a14a16b334cb42f8798&_e=-XeTqrhU_o9RLV1iTAx2EbAsthSgYe1vmAQrzQ29v8WXSc74qZajV21TvP6ioxyJ0kZ6BvbR7UUO-3paVb8S1CiWP56HRuuqwHMB4Qab6sjIypznH3M_AAJZzIXFDRg_DrETGAEnY20_H6GgWJx_nUo1u27NpMvHyWN7X5q9ubLlpuF880r09eYvkiAKacaU3akibG9u0fGiHIU_MMvYcQN9_M8HtDzfGdFeol1tv118RQXKRtm6XxN3DKUNfzZScSCCInu7csSCHkPsAHxEMxnyXbGcrmLK2MwI4boehcgQF77fzcGaPJBjCmRi8H795RmuOubnDWRzS-37Ene8Z49l4BF9a_qLXy-q7zbn4I-jEdTU0En59YhYNSDwrZAy)

I’m up against a career politician who wouldn’t know the definition of service if it slapped him in the face, Peter.

clean_body: Either the President is that aloof, or you are irrelevant | " Either the President is that aloof, or you are irrelevant" That is what I asked the Secretary of Defense yesterday. After Secretary Austin went missing this past January, the American people deserve answers about our national security. And my job is to get those answers. I learned yesterday that President Biden goes days without talking to his own Defense Secretary on a regular basis. I shouldn't be surprised by this lack of responsibility and transparency from an Administration that refuses to take our national security seriously. | How Is it acceptable for the President to remain disengaged from his Defense Secretary for days? Such a lack of communication between the Commander-in-Chief and the individual tasked with overseeing our national defense is unprecedented and unacceptable. | | **_On this day in 1965, John Lewis and courageous leaders embarked on a journey from Selma to Montgomery, Alabama that forever changed the course of our nation's history._**

| Despite what you may believe, my affinity for The Big Lebowski isn’t because of The Dude’s proclivity for White Russians.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=5921%2E5257348%2EywGb0O)
Derek, there’s reason for celebration this week: We’re moving on to the November election, and it’s thanks to the incredible support of this grassroots team!
But there is also grave reason for concern. Donald Trump swept nearly every Super Tuesday contest, and Nikki Haley announced that she is suspending her presidential campaign.
**And as far as that tragic development is concerned, to quote my favorite movie on the occasion of its 26th anniversary this week — the Coen Brothers’ classic _The Big Lebowski — and my inner Walter Sobchak:_**
**_“Donny, you’re out of your element.”_**
**[As The Dude abides, will you abide by my humble request for support in fighting back against Donald Trump, Steve Garvey, and the MAGA movement with a $3 donation today?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em.YceVvx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240307_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=4&akid=5921%2E5257348%2EywGb0O)**

Despite what you may believe, my affinity for _The Big Lebowski_ isn’t because of The Dude’s proclivity for White Russians.
I doubt there’s much I actually have in common with The Dude, or, uh, His Dudeness, or uh, Duder, or El Duderino if you’re not into the whole brevity thing...**unless it’s having roughly as many nicknames from a certain former disgraced occupant of the Oval Office.**
But I do love gifting _The Big Lebowski_ to my staff on holidays.
I’ve got a license plate frame with Walter Sobchak’s immortal guidance: _“I don’t roll on Shabbos.”_
I often note when a rug really ties the room together.
And in my opinion, the line that most often comes up working in politics, and my reaction to Matt Gaetz when he attacked Kevin McCarthy for being an empty suit:
_“You’re not wrong. You’re just an a-hole.”_
**[If you abide, pitch in a few bucks to our campaign to become a General Election Founding Donor.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em.YceVvx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240307_AM1_V1_S1&t=11&akid=5921%2E5257348%2EywGb0O)**
I hope you’re able to take a few hours to enjoy this classic and some laughs along the way.
Eff it Dude, let’s go bowling.
— Adam

## **9-0**
On Monday, The Supreme Court of the United States ruled unanimously that states lack the power to reject presidential candidates on the basis of accusations of rebellion or insurrection. The decision restored President Trump’s name on Colorado’s ballot as well as several other state ballots.
In America, our justice system is anchored on the premise of “innocent until proven guilty.” In America, we have the right to vote for anyone we choose. To do otherwise would be the end of our democratic republic; and the end of free and fair elections, which are the cornerstone of that republic.
From a legal standpoint, the Colorado case was always a stretch.
Colorado cited Amendment 14, Section 3 of the Constitution of the United States, which states, in relevant part, that candidates are ineligible for office if they "shall have engaged in insurrection or rebellion" against the Constitution of the United States. That didn’t happen.
**Of course, facts are immaterial to our totalitarian media class, whose reaction to the 9-0 (UNANIMOUS) ruling was nothing short of hysterical (in every sense of the word)**. Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. name: Team AOC
subject: Are you on other political email lists?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Are you on other political email lists?
If so, you probably regularly receive urgent and panicky emails asking for money. Too many politicians and organizations see their grassroots supporters as an ATM. They use scare tactics, guilt and shame, and downright misleading language to coax people into donating.
It’s bad, and getting worse. Team AOC is determined to rise above that and treat you and our other grassroots supporters with respect. Here’s what we believe:
\- Instead of scaring you to donate, we want to inspire you to take action.
\- Instead of guilt tripping you for not donating enough, we want our emails to provide value to you. We try to send out informative, educational content.
\- Instead of misleading you about fake 5X matches or faux threats, we’re honest with you about what’s going on and how you can help.
\- Instead of only hitting you up when we need money, we’ll also send you opportunities to volunteer or help other candidates and causes who need it. **In 2024 alone, our movement has supported progressives like Jamaal Bowman and causes such as flood relief in California.**
But just like all the other campaigns in your inbox, we do have fundraising goals and deadlines. Everything we raise each quarter is detailed in our public FEC report, and we want to post the biggest possible fundraising numbers. But we’re not going to scare or scam you into donating. We’ll just ask nicely because your donations to AOC are important and meaningful.
[Would you be able to make a $5 donation to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez right now to help us power AOC's campaign as the election cycle gets into full swing? We’d really appreciate it.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240307-1.31mNJn&refcode=em20240307-5949-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240307-1.31mNJn&refcode=em20240307-5949-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ)**
If you can’t make a donation today, that’s okay too. We still want you here, and we still appreciate you reading our emails.
The truth is that this email list is powerful. It’s powerful precisely because you’re here, with so many others. It’s powerful because when so many of us take collective action all at once, we can make real change.
So, maybe you can’t [donate right now.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240307-1.31mNJn&refcode=em20240307-5949-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ) But maybe you’ll get something of value from the next email we send. Or perhaps you’ll join us for a volunteer activity down the road.
No matter what, we’re glad you’re here. Thanks for being part of this movement,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20240307-1?refcode=em20240307-5949-P_FND_EGR_GOL&t=22&refcode2=5949_2526796_PIJJrZ&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20240307-5949-P_FND_EGR_GOL&t=23&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ)**
---|---
[](https://www.facebook.com/OcasioCortez/?t=24&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ) | [](https://twitter.com/AOC?t=25&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ) | [](https://www.instagram.com/aoc/?t=26&akid=5949%2E2526796%2EPIJJrZ)
---|---|---
Email us: [speak@ocasiocortez.com](mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

body:
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.
Peter, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.
And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.
[**Please, split a $5 or $10 donation****between Bob Casey and my campaign****. Whatever you can afford can help us build the team that’s going to win in Arizona. Hey everyone:

I wanted to take space to recognize what happened 59 years ago today in Selma, Alabama.

Peaceful demonstrators, taking action against the constant voter suppression and racist attacks, were brutalized by Alabama State Troopers — because they were Black.

Leading them was the great Rep. John Lewis. Long before he served in Congress, he was a true activist.

His commitment to our democracy, to uplifting Black Americans, to equality, it inspires me daily.

I even got a tattoo in his honor: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80508983/459551878/-407916182?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.03.07_B1_BloodySunday_T1a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzODYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTkzNTBlODEtYWNkYy1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j9KMCbPGjkejewVuSY-qU_xrmuvE9jalsXBX_8kmxGQ=) The Black heart represents the struggle of Black Americans. And the blood tears are for all the blood shed in the struggle for equality. And the red lightning symbolizes the chaos that ensues when you get into Good Trouble.

I got this tattoo to remind me of the fights and struggles that came before me, **fights like Bloody Sunday.**

_I’m running for Congress to protect the democracy that people like John Lewis built._

And I share it because I want the millions of other women who’ve made the decision to seek abortion care to know that they’re not alone. When I was 21, I found out I was pregnant. I was married and wanted to start a family, but a devastating medical diagnosis changed all my plans. My doctors told me I had an aortic aneurysm at risk of rupture. To treat it, I first needed to have an abortion. **That abortion saved my life.** My right to make the decision that was best for me, my health, and my future was protected by _Roe v. Wade_. Women in Tennessee and other GOP-controlled states are now denied _any_ choice in their reproductive futures. It’s abhorrent. Let me be clear, the right to make our own reproductive health care decisions is fundamental. Women _cannot_ be equal if we don’t have control over our own bodies. When I get to Washington, I won’t hesitate to use every power available to demand a restoration of our reproductive freedoms at the federal level. clean_body: Your right to reproductive health care is fundamental. | Folks, as a young woman, I had an abortion. It’s not a secret. It’s not shameful. And I share it because I want the millions of other women who’ve made the decision to seek abortion care to know that they’re not alone. When I was 21, I found out I was pregnant. I was married and wanted to start a family, but a devastating medical diagnosis changed all my plans. My doctors told me I had an aortic aneurysm at risk of rupture. To treat it, I first needed to have an abortion. That abortion saved my life. My right to make the decision that was best for me, my health, and my future was protected by Roe v. Wade. Women in Tennessee and other GOP-controlled states are now denied any choice in their reproductive futures. It’s abhorrent. Let me be clear, the right to make our own reproductive health care decisions is fundamental. Women cannot be equal if we don’t have control over our own bodies. When I get to Washington, I won’t hesitate to use every power available to demand a restoration of our reproductive freedoms at the federal level. We have to secure our rights and prevent radicals like Marsha Blackburn from enacting a national ban. = | = = = With you, Gloria = | Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. For too long, elected officials like Marsha Blackburn have done absolutely nothing to make Tennesseans’ lives better. The only interests they’ve cared about are special interests. The only people they’ve championed are their donors. Gloria will advocate for real solutions to protect our communities from gun violence, make health care more affordable and accessible for all of us, secure access to the ballot box, and defend reproductive rights. | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Gloria for Tennessee Contributions or gifts to Gloria for Tennessee are not tax deductible. disclaimer_text: paid for by the 1% and big industries, that don’t really care about putting people over their own payday
body:
and why I’d do it again.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1052%2E62735%2EGrSVrK)
I got a surprise phone call last October —
I wasn’t expecting it. I didn’t ask for it. **But by the end of it, I had turned down a $20 million campaign contribution.**
And Peter, I’d turn it down all over again.
Why? Because I meant it when I said this is a people-powered campaign. I won’t be bought, bossed, or bullied into compromising my principles, and I _damn sure_ am not going to run a campaign that takes marching orders from the ultra-rich.
No, I jumped into this race to represent working families and everyday Michiganders — _real people._ No one else.
**But here’s the thing: Without grassroots support, I don’t stand a chance against those career politicians.**
[**Can you chip in $20 to boost my campaign’s grassroots momentum? I’m counting on working folks like you to fuel our people-powered movement.**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/716?t=2&akid=1052%2E62735%2EGrSVrK)
I’m no Washington insider — I’m a single dad, union organizer, and small business owner who has watched our current system fail working families over and over. At the core of it all are too many politicians in Washington, bought and paid for by the 1% and big industries, that don’t really care about putting people over their own payday.
So while we may not have the same financial muscle as Washington insiders, I know we’ve got something even better: A movement of everyday folks who are tired of our broken system, tired of dirty money in politics, and ready for dynamic change. **If that sounds like you, this is your invitation to join us, Peter.**
[**Look, I don’t expect my supporters to cut $20 million checks to my campaign — but I DO hope you’ll chip in $20 today to give me the grassroots firepower I need to win. Every dollar counts!**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/716?t=3&akid=1052%2E62735%2EGrSVrK)
**[CHIP IN $20](https://act.hillharper.com/go/716?t=4&akid=1052%2E62735%2EGrSVrK)**
**[CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.hillharper.com/go/717?t=5&akid=1052%2E62735%2EGrSVrK)**
This is a movement built of, by, and for working Michiganders — and it’s going to stay that way through our victory on Election Day. Thanks so much for being part of the team.
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

| | Hey Peter — Today, I'm reaching out to share some thoughts following Tuesday's election. Although there are still tens of thousands of votes to count, things did not go our way and we won't be advancing to the November election. I'm incredibly humbled by the support I've received throughout this campaign. **I want to thank everyone — family, friends, volunteers, campaign staff, and community leaders — who joined our campaign and shared our message of solutions-oriented leadership.** Building this movement would not have been possible without you, Peter. While these aren't the results we wanted, I am happy to congratulate my friend Assemblymember Laura Friedman on her successful, hard-fought campaign; it looks like she will be taking on a Republican in November. Getting to know the other candidates eager to uplift our community has been such a gift in this experience. I look forward to working with all of them to deliver for the communities of California's 30th congressional district. I am so proud of this campaign, but, more than that, so humbled by the experience. My overwhelming sentiment over the last 24 hours has truly been one of gratitude: I'm grateful for my community, for my family, and for all of you in my corner. You make the successes all the more satisfying and the losses all the easier to bear. It has been said that victory has a thousand fathers, but defeat is an orphan; I have not found that at all true with you. **I believe in politics because I believe in people–in our ability to do amazing things when we come together.** That belief is undeterred. At a time when our politics seems so cynical and our world so bleak, I remember that we are here because of the choices people make. We can make better choices. Not just the big important ones in elections every few years, but the little ones every day. How we treat one another. How we show up for each other. It struck me as I was talking to voters at their doorsteps over the last few weeks that the world is not often changed by grand gestures, but by almost invisible ones: acts of kindness and inclusion and tolerance that start to change the way we treat one another. At its best, that is what public service can be: a manifestation of our belief in one another. I remain deeply committed to that work, on the School Board and as a citizen, and I thank you for the opportunity to serve. Onward, _Nick_ |

# ONLY 2 DAYS REMAINING
---
| Friends, There are roughly 100 bills already sitting on Governor Youngkin's desk that require action before midnight, Friday, March 8. These are bills that were signed by both House Speaker and Senate President before last Friday.
Many bills under the accelerated timeline address top issues such as gun control legislation, reproductive rights and raising the state's minimum wage floor.
Among the so-called seven-day bills:
* Banning legacy university admissions,
* Re-enrolling in a program to share voter information with other states,
* Requiring health insurance cover contraception.

Only 2 days remaining to finish all of the bills currently in the Virginia Senate. All bills are in conference at this point, meaning a handful of senators and delegates will hash out any differences in the remaining bills and then make recommendations to the full Senate to accept or reject amendments made on the remaining bills.
In addition, today the Senate was presented with the final budget that has been hashed out by Senate and House conferees. By law, legislators have 48 hours to review the budget. On Saturday, legislators will vote up or down on the budget.
in the biennial budget, teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees would receive raises of 3% in each year of the new two-year budget under an agreement that General Assembly budget negotiators unveiled today, Thursday, March 7.
The revised assembly budget for the current fiscal year does not include budget language to finance a $2 billion professional sports and entertainment district in Alexandria, an exclusion that Governor Glenn Youngkin called a "colossal mistake."
---
|
---
Going forward, once lawmakers send the governor a budget, he could pursue an amendment and restore the language in the budget, or he could call a special session.
Legislators could also reject the budget bill and send it back to the conference committee for further consideration.
Stay tuned. We still have much to cover over the next 48 hours.

| | | **BREAKING UPDATE:** Yesterday, North Carolina AG Josh Stein warned us about the extremist he's running against to be North Carolina's next Governor. This nut-job, Republican Mark Robinson, is a Holocaust denier who called school shootings fake and 9/11 "an inside job." **Now we've learned from an unearthed Facebook post he said "I Absolutely Wanna Go Back To The America Where Women Can't Vote."** Re-read that despicable sentence, if you can. [**And please consider giving whatever you can to Josh Stein so that he, and not a sick, conspiracy-wielding bigot, is the next Governor of North Carolina.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4b76d850-be3d-47b4-9733-fe183dc32099/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) — Cliff

But let me be clear: We can’t let up. Not one bit. [**The next eight months will present challenge after challenge. We’re going to have to work hard every day to protect North Carolina – that’s why I’m counting on your help. The general election starts now: Will you split a contribution between my campaign and Blue Amp Action now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T89f681f8-b6a6-4a7c-b03f-92d69c44709c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | | Early on, my parents taught me that some things are always worth fighting for — no matter the opposition. My dad helped found the first integrated law firm in North Carolina. He and his partners fought _against_ discrimination and _for_ equality. They kept up that fight even after extremists firebombed their office, burning it to the ground. **Today, we’re once again at a crossroads. Extremists in North Carolina and across the country are threatening the values we hold most dear. ** Mark Robinson – a conspiracy theorist and far-right extremist – was just selected to lead the top of the ticket for NC’s GOP in November. He’s pushing for a total ban on abortion, promising to further strip funding for public schools, and threatening North Carolinians’ voting rights. He’s also touted dangerous conspiracy theories: calling a school shooting survivor a “crisis actor,” questioning whether 9/11 was an inside job, and claiming the Holocaust was “hogwash.” Mark Robinson is one of the most extreme statewide-elected Republicans _in the country_ – and yet the latest polls show us statistically TIED. The National GOP knows North Carolina is its top pickup opportunity, so we’re expecting them to flood money into our state to back Robinson. [**It will take everything we have to defeat Robinson and the National GOP on November 5th. Split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action now to help us win this toss-up race and defeat extremism in North Carolina →**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5608599b-a434-473d-889b-90ee06e4e18a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| I’ve spent the past 25 years serving North Carolina. I’ve advocated for consumers mistreated by predatory corporations, worked to keep communities and families safe, and defended reproductive and voting rights. North Carolina is our home. My wife Anna and I both grew up here. We raised our three kids here. They all went to North Carolina public schools, just like Anna and I did. I love this state and think it’s the best place to live, work, and raise a family. [**But far-right extremists are taking us down the wrong path. We can beat them with your help – please join us in the fight for North Carolina’s future by contributing whatever you can today.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T938974ee-7d9a-48e6-973f-fbc68e1a454a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you to everyone who has supported our campaign so far and invested in our vision for a stronger, safer North Carolina. I can’t wait to continue in this fight together. Let’s get going! Josh Stein

Peter -- In just hours, President Biden will deliver his State of the Union address to the nation. But before he does, I am asking if you can contribute $25 to our reelection campaign. If you understand the stakes of this election, and that is all you need to hear, then please use this link to donate: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/Biden-SOTU**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt0n_-PX9mL8yHKUav8QI_tCu5zo5UDj__wcQw1t0mNhWcdkqv39l_M-k6c7ereIwNyJrUMa1pQ334pLAGw0DisKMdO34LQvD748kSxOqZJqAqynTvNVLBqtjXvFtVgRCV1CIW14pn_KbcyFNt-q9Vdju9y7iIyPx0qG38ZwYm/44g/iu8LQp1qRRm5PT_fE235Wg/h0/h001.-jt0sjmDuzCCJUtskFSBzOtncJLTRdju81rioGT9YkE) Otherwise, let me try to make the case for why your donation matters so much -- especially tonight. But before he does, I am asking if you can contribute $25 to our reelection campaign. If you understand the stakes of this election, and that is all you need to hear, then please use this link to donate: Otherwise, let me try to make the case for why your donation matters so much -- especially tonight. The truth is, America's democracy is not guaranteed. It is only as strong as our willingness to fight for it, to guard it, and never take it for granted. Protecting our democracy takes struggle. It takes sacrifice. But there is joy in it. And there is progress. Because we the people have the power to build a better future. So to everyone who is a part of this campaign, to everyone keeping up the fight, you are doing something. You are the reason that I know we are going to bring our country closer to realizing its great promise. The President and I cannot win this election without you. As you read this, MAGA Republicans are probably donating lots of money to try to make sure this is President Biden's last State of the Union. We need your help to fight back. Especially today. subject: The anti-police mob is putting my son in jail
body:
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/G6OdD1E789c-9KrZS-3xAg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnzJ7SP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi84MTdkMjgyNy04Y2E4LTQ3MzEtYmQyMy05YzhlMDhiOTU3ZDI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA3X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1BRlJXA3NwY0IKZeogDeplARwqmVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/G6OdD1E789c-9KrZS-3xAg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnzJ7SP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi84MTdkMjgyNy04Y2E4LTQ3MzEtYmQyMy05YzhlMDhiOTU3ZDI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA3X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1BRlJXA3NwY0IKZeogDeplARwqmVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/G6OdD1E789c-9KrZS-3xAg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnzJ7SP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi84MTdkMjgyNy04Y2E4LTQ3MzEtYmQyMy05YzhlMDhiOTU3ZDI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA3X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1BRlJXA3NwY0IKZeogDeplARwqmVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/G6OdD1E789c-9KrZS-3xAg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnzJ7SP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi84MTdkMjgyNy04Y2E4LTQ3MzEtYmQyMy05YzhlMDhiOTU3ZDI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA3X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1BRlJXA3NwY0IKZeogDeplARwqmVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/G6OdD1E789c-9KrZS-3xAg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnzJ7SP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi84MTdkMjgyNy04Y2E4LTQ3MzEtYmQyMy05YzhlMDhiOTU3ZDI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA3X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1BRlJXA3NwY0IKZeogDeplARwqmVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/G6OdD1E789c-9KrZS-3xAg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnzJ7SP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi84MTdkMjgyNy04Y2E4LTQ3MzEtYmQyMy05YzhlMDhiOTU3ZDI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA3X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1BRlJXA3NwY0IKZeogDeplARwqmVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

**AN OFFICIAL CAMPAIGN UPDATE FROM THE DESK OF KARI LAKE**
Fellow American,
