# It's Time for REAL COMMON SENSE in CONGRESS.
,

I am running for Congress because I don't want any wishy-washy politicians representing my family. That's the only message that can win this November because we all know its true. **It's called common sense!**

Our nation is under assault by the Biden administration \- the open Border, outrageous taxes, arresting journalists!, warmongers pushing us to the brink of World War III.

WHERE'S THE COMMON SENSE LEADERSHIP?!

And just today the Alliance Defending Freedom with whom I've served defending Western Marylanders in court, announced in a press release that Congressman Jim Jordan and other patriots [uncovered the Biden Admin Treasury Dept. spying on American's bank accounts searching for words such as "TRUMP", "firearms" and even...get this..."anti-COVID-19 lockdown policies including "vaccinations."](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=fd4b22e861&e=5bb5efcda7)
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=f50b1ba56d&e=5bb5efcda7)
WOW - what country are we in? Remember this if you watch him tonight on the State of the Union.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=0889a59815&e=5bb5efcda7)
I am running to make a difference and need your help now. But unless you join me, the far Left will win. Here's my common sense pledge:

1\. I WILL KEEP MY WORD: Americans are fed up with ALL politicians who do not keep their word. Thankfully President Trump is winning and like him I will keep my word to you. In Congress I will vote America First - stop sending money overseas (no more money to Ukraine!) and secure our Border instead, ensure our rights are protected, fight for a maximum wage, good schools and strong parental rights. I did this as State Delegate and also passed my unanimous anti-Border-trafficking legislation protecting women and children.

2\. COMMON SENSE - SEAL THE BORDER NOW: (1) Seal the Border now and save our country; (2) bring back jobs, lower ALL taxes, affordable housing, especially our seniors and veterans so they are not put out of their homes. Western Maryland is hurting with outrageous taxes and our jobs and economy is suffering. I was raised on a local farm and worked my way through college while working three part-time jobs. Our kids deserve better; I will fight for you.

3\. MAKE WESTERN MARYLAND WEALTHY AGAIN: We can protect the Bay and stop raw sewage and toxic dumps - which I did as an elected Town Council President, while not shutting down electric plants and sending jobs elsewhere. We in Western Maryland are sitting on one of the world’s largest oil & gas deposits called the Marcellus Shale and we would become the wealthiest people and state in the world if we use our 100% CLEAN LNG and oil to ship to our ports for the market. I would propose a clean energy bill in Congress to open up the Maryland LNG to bring back jobs and wealth to the area. Drill baby drill - and watch our wealth grow.

Join me at [CoxforCongress.org](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=540b583e07&e=5bb5efcda7) and I humbly ask for your vote and your urgent support today. For those who have already donated - thank you - please forward this to your friends and ask for them to consider supporting me and consider becoming a monthly sponsor!

Freedom and Victory,
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=665f0d79f9&e=5bb5efcda7)
Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (R-MD6) P.S. Voting begins in Maryland in just 24 days by mail-in ballot. Now is the moment I need to reach voters.

Friend,

It’s Wesley Hunt.

As we head into another election year, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I’m running.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas.

After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=5782c61b4bb84780879be011d8645738&_e=VXmIAtzXibMZ6c8ykoJEitbnZHfNucTEkM1qtNmiK4Ln9QcO-SwvaNsYpeqRAv1ZK94BpgrBxV3JLIWDIFdbKvAibvSnfoG4gx5sSZUhQ2W4LI5hAGqak2zsvLvxGcjO2v8o8YSfVd4yeqWF7dvKjTfND_qjT-Lw85iOwNXgFOfdq1Yi_C1asZofRLX1Qf0624BN39bM67soi1PN1mZ_nxd31hn0WX59jBPMSuG9SD72L01TXF6yaAK50XaLeK7moJNnFXXUE8YbzuPjMzrZ1UimzPU3trOs5_QPO4FBwpg%3D) _(Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point)_
My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps.

After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

I never thought I would get involved in politics, but after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation, by running for the United States Congress.

I knew that challenging the DC Washington elite wouldn’t be easy, but after flying Apache helicopters over Iraq, I knew I was prepared to take on the tough fights.

**Join me in the fight to save the future of America.**

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=5782c61b4bb84780879be011d8645738&_e=VXmIAtzXibMZ6c8ykoJEitbnZHfNucTEkM1qtNmiK4Ln9QcO-SwvaNsYpeqRAv1ZK94BpgrBxV3JLIWDIFdbKvAibvSnfoG4gx5sSZUhQ2W4LI5hAGqak2zsvLvxGcjO2v8o8YSfVd4yeqWF7dvKjfzH_SCDD4IdylRClFUGB9NM0kU9HzMPpArr7Svsut-aKZ0aGgvVzxWjIJOjVJtnYiwykC9slRp6ducLMJu4-61mXHS_hyhrIj19zwtc7KMkae4ax6DsALyuzdKzLODMpVGHntO4IwO-pbiSrQUN1es%3D)

**This picture** is my number one reason for serving Texans in Congress. Being a husband and a father has taught me selflessness and dedication and has instilled in me a desire to better our country for the next generation.

Now, here we are in one of the most consequential election years of our lifetime. The majority we fought so hard for in 2022 hangs in the balance, and conservative ideals are under fire every day.

**Nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and community here at home.

| [**JOIN TEAM HUNT - DONATE TODAY**](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=5782c61b4bb84780879be011d8645738&_e=VXmIAtzXibMZ6c8ykoJEitbnZHfNucTEkM1qtNmiK4Ln9QcO-SwvaNsYpeqRAv1ZK94BpgrBxV3JLIWDIFdbKvAibvSnfoG4gx5sSZUhQ2W4LI5hAGqak2zsvLvxGcjO2v8o8YSfVd4yeqWF7dvKjWVoKyTP_iWmT8nogpf79rep6sPSvJzdHaFqUvEGyWzLj2XkbyiDsvAj34qkOYS95Hxu80NcvotDJvjOz-9QOpTLue_5wOzwOH9YUoLpVSs2fl8tAahqWiPA7uj_Ut97GsKFEW2jila2oxoCEypUKKM%3D)
---

I hope you’ll join me as we fight to put an end to all the damage the Left has done over the past three years.**

Thank you,

Wesley Hunt

clean_body: | | | ** Far-right Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito is really bummed that those who discriminate against LGBTQIA+ people could be called bigots. We’re not afraid to say it: anyone who treats LGBTQIA+ with hatred and intolerant ... is a bigot. Just this month, Tennessee enacted a law allowing state officials to “opt out” of solemnizing same-sex marriages, and our Supreme Court has revealed its hostility to the LGBTQIA+ community. Peter, we can’t take anything for granted - we need Democratic majorities in Congress who will defend our constitutional and human rights! Justice Alito griped that as a result of Obergefell v. Hodges , which legalized gay marriage, it wouldn’t be acceptable to discriminate against the LGBTQIA+ people. When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , Justice Thomas hinted that Obergefell needed to be re-evaluated - same-sex marriage isn’t safe. Derek’s opponent Rep. Obernolte voted against the Equality Act, which would protect the LGBTQIA+ community from discrimination, and the Supreme Court has demonstrated that it will not protect our human rights.** Thanks for your support. -Derek Marshall for Congress is a Democrat running for Congress in California's 23rd District. The contrast between Biden and Trump:
| | | Team, it’s Senator Schumer. **[I have an important favor to ask: Will you chip in $5 _(becomes $15!)_ to support Senate Democrats before President Biden's State of the Union?](https://go.dscc.org/go/17474?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240307-ChuckSchumer-SchumerSOTUBidenVsTrump-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240307-ChuckSchumer-SchumerSOTUBidenVsTrump-Pros-sl1&akid=13857%2E9716520%2EP7Vta_)**

Let me explain why this is so important:

This evening, President Biden will deliver the final State of the Union address of his first term. As I get ready to attend this important annual tradition, I keep thinking how President Biden's and Donald Trump's versions of this speech _couldn't be more different._

When I was preparing for Donald Trump's State of the Union addresses, I always used to hope he'd talk about important issues -- like how we could work together to invest in American infrastructure or expand access to affordable health care. **Instead, as the nation watched, Donald Trump used his platform to spout extremist rhetoric and divide Americans, as MAGA Republicans in Congress applauded.**

But now, when I sit in the House chamber and watch President Biden's addresses, I'm overwhelmed with a sense of pride. **President Biden uses the State of the Union to unite Americans instead of divide us, and to lay out bold plans for the future -- plans we've delivered on, time and again.**

We simply _can't_ go back down the road of darkness and division that we'll face if Trump and his MAGA allies gain control of the Senate. Under President Biden and Senate Democrats, America has so many reasons to be optimistic. So let's make sure we keep moving forward.

Friend, I’m Colin Allred, and I'm the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Ted Cruz.
**Now, the real fight begins.** I'm ready to outwork, outraise, and out-organize Ted Cruz to win this thing, and with multiple polls already showing me TIED with Ted, I'm confident we can do it. But I also know Cruz is backed by wealthy mega donors who will spend whatever it takes to keep him in office.
**That’s why I need you with me: Please, will you chip in $5 – or whatever you can spare – to help reach my $1 million General Election Kickoff goal?**
[**Every dollar you can spare will power our people-powered movement through Election Day so we can defeat Ted Cruz and deliver better, stronger leadership for the people of Texas. Will you help kick our campaign off in a huge way by donating $5 or more to me and GIFFORDS PAC right now? →**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24-ca.AnyHug&refcode=em240307-2-30&t=2&akid=7731%2E3935704%2EZSZo0v)

I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.**
_Now, I’m ready for my next challenge:_ firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done.

Please, rush $5, or whatever you can spare, to help me and GIFFORDS PAC win in Texas, defeat Ted Cruz, and give Texans the leadership we deserve. →**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24-ca.AnyHug&refcode=em240307-2-30&t=9&akid=7731%2E3935704%2EZSZo0v)
Thank you so much for being a part of my team. Your support has gotten me this far, and it's why I know we can win.
Let's do this,
Colin Allred

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Rolling Stone is the latest media outlet to cast a spotlight on “the wrath
of AIPAC” against anyone who dares to speak out for Palestinian human
rights this election cycle — especially our Justice Democrats incumbents
in the Squad.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240307.DaYyS3&refcode=em20240307-33684&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=33684%2E1203867%2EiCAG2k ]Rolling Stone: AIPAC Targets Progressives With $100 Million in Its
Coffers. Members of The Squad and other progressives running in Democratic
primaries are targets of the pro-Israel group largely funded by
Republicans and Trump donors. Photo of Ayanna Pressley, AOC, and Rashida
Tlaib.

The GOP megadonor-funded group has already begun spending some of their
$100 million war chest on attack ads and primary campaigns against
progressive champions like Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush, Summer Lee, Ilhan
Omar, and Rashida Tlaib this year. Their goal? Oust them from Congress in
2024.

AIPAC may outspend us, but we can still beat them through grassroots
people power. Just look at Tuesday’s primary results in California: AIPAC
spent $5 million against a Democratic candidate who didn’t even call for a
ceasefire, but mildly criticized Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin
Netanyahu. Despite their flood of dark money and attack ads into the race,
they lost.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240307.DaYyS3&refcode=em20240307-33684&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33684%2E1203867%2EiCAG2k ]Help Justice Democrats take on “the wrath of AIPAC” and protect their
top targets in the Squad: pitch in $3 or whatever you can
afford today to fuel our fight ahead of the upcoming primary elections.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240307.DaYyS3&refcode=em20240307-33684&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=33684%2E1203867%2EiCAG2k ]Contribute $3

Together, we can keep our Squad of young, Black and brown, working-class
progressives in Congress fighting not only for Palestinian rights, but for
Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and other bold solutions to the
challenges we face.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=33684%2E1203867%2EiCAG2k ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=33684%2E1203867%2EiCAG2k ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240307-33684-footer&t=1024&refcode2=33684_1203867_iCAG2k&akid=33684%2E1203867%2EiCAG2k

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. Over the past 150 days, Israel’s government has killed over 12,000 children in Gaza (among at least 30,000 people slaughtered), orphaned 17,000 children, wounded more than 72,000 people, driven more than 2 million people out of their homes, and is now starving millions.
None of this would be possible without U.S. support and weapons.
Now, 1.5 million Palestinians are trapped in the southernmost city of Rafah, the last so-called “safe zone” in Gaza. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu has bombed Rafah and warned that he would begin a ground invasion into Rafah on March 10 (the start of Ramadan), regardless of a potential temporary ceasefire deal.
Rep. Cori Bush and I recently sent President Biden a letter and held a press conference last week, urging him to decisively oppose any invasion or bombardment of Rafah and facilitate an immediate, lasting ceasefire.
Our country is already the biggest funder of Israel’s military and the largest arms exporter to Israel. We have immense influence and leverage, and we still have an opportunity to save millions of people’s lives in Gaza.

Tomorrow, President Biden will deliver the annual State of the Union address. Millions of Americans will tune in to watch his televised speech to Congress.
On the same day, organizations around the country are preparing a People’s State of the Union rally in Washington, D.C. to express outrage that our government keeps handing over billions of our tax dollars to fund war and genocide—all while neglecting our communities’ urgent needs in the United States.
Their main demands are: “Immediate and permanent ceasefire now! Stop U.S. aid for Israel’s genocide against Palestinians! Fund the peoples’ and planet’s needs—not war and militarism.”
Recent polls have found that among the people who voted for Biden in 2020, 62% want the U.S. to stop sending weapons to Israel, and half “think that Israel is committing genocide against Palestinian civilians.”1
Two-thirds of U.S. voters continue to support a _permanent_ ceasefire—including 77% of Democrats.2 President Biden must urgently listen to the majority of his base of supporters.
Yesterday, 20% of Minnesota voters and 13% of North Carolina voters voted “uncommitted” or “no preference” to register their dissent with President Biden’s support for genocide, following the 101,000 Michigan voters who used our democracy to make their voices heard last week.

Last week, Biden’s administration blocked a UN statement condemning Israeli soldiers for massacring over 100 Palestinian civilians waiting for food.
But, our movement’s pressure is shifting some of the Biden administration’s statements about Gaza, and we need to keep it up to see real change. Millions of lives hang in the balance.
Last week, my colleague Rep. clean_body: This week’s State of the Union is an opportunity for President Biden to call for an immediate, lasting ceasefire in Gaza. | | | Friend, Today, President Biden will address millions of Americans in his televised State of the Union address. More than 77% of Democrats support a permanent ceasefire, and 62% of people who voted for Biden in 2020 want him to stop sending weapons to Israel. Many Americans have felt unseen and outraged, watching our government hand over billions of our tax dollars to fund war and genocide—all while neglecting our communities’ urgent needs in the United States. | Over the past 150 days, Israel’s government has killed over 12,000 children in Gaza (among at least 30,000 people slaughtered), orphaned 17,000 children, wounded more than 72,000 people, driven more than 2 million people out of their homes, and is now starving millions. None of this would be possible without U.S. support and weapons. Now, 1.5 million Palestinians are trapped in the southernmost city of Rafah, the last so-called “safe zone” in Gaza. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu has bombed Rafah and warned that he would begin a ground invasion into Rafah on March 10 (the start of Ramadan), regardless of a potential temporary ceasefire deal. Rep. Cori Bush and I recently sent President Biden a letter and held a press conference last week, urging him to decisively oppose any invasion or bombardment of Rafah and facilitate an immediate, lasting ceasefire. Our country is already the biggest funder of Israel’s military and the largest arms exporter to Israel. We have immense influence and leverage, and we still have an opportunity to save millions of people’s lives in Gaza. Thank you. Together, we’ll keep demanding dignity and equal rights for everyone. In service and solidarity, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Wed, Mar 6, 2024 Subject: Sign on to demand President Biden call for a lasting ceasefire in this week’s State of the Union To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, Tomorrow, President Biden will deliver the annual State of the Union address. Millions of Americans will tune in to watch his televised speech to Congress. On the same day, organizations around the country are preparing a People’s State of the Union rally in Washington, D.C. to express outrage that our government keeps handing over billions of our tax dollars to fund war and genocide—all while neglecting our communities’ urgent needs in the United States. Their main demands are: “Immediate and permanent ceasefire now! Stop U.S. aid for Israel’s genocide against Palestinians! Fund the peoples’ and planet’s needs—not war and militarism.” Recent polls have found that among the people who voted for Biden in 2020, 62% want the U.S. to stop sending weapons to Israel, and half “think that Israel is committing genocide against Palestinian civilians.”1 Two-thirds of U.S. voters continue to support a permanent ceasefire—including 77% of Democrats.2 President Biden must urgently listen to the majority of his base of supporters. Yesterday, 20% of Minnesota voters and 13% of North Carolina voters voted “uncommitted” or “no preference” to register their dissent with President Biden’s support for genocide, following the 101,000 Michigan voters who used our democracy to make their voices heard last week. Instead of using our government’s leverage to stop the killing of civilians, President Biden continues to send bombs to Israel’s military, veto UN resolutions for a ceasefire, and cut funding from the UN agency providing aid in Gaza. Last week, Biden’s administration blocked a UN statement condemning Israeli soldiers for massacring over 100 Palestinian civilians waiting for food. But, our movement’s pressure is shifting some of the Biden administration’s statements about Gaza, and we need to keep it up to see real change. Millions of lives hang in the balance. Last week, my colleague Rep. Cori Bush and I wrote to President Biden, urging him to facilitate an immediate and lasting ceasefire, end the use of the U.S.’s veto in the UN Security Council to protect far-right Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, and end any additional transfer of funds, weapons, or military equipment to the Israeli government. We asked him to decisively oppose any invasion or bombardment of Rafah, where over 1 million people are trapped as the Israeli military prepares a ground invasion for March 10, regardless of a potential temporary ceasefire deal. Thank you for demanding a government that’s about us, the people. We still have an opportunity to save millions of people’s lives left in Gaza, and to support life-affirming investments in our communities. clean_body: Tune in tonight shortly following President Biden’s address for the Working Families Party State of the Union Response delivered by Philadelphia City Councilmember Nicolas O’Rourke. | | | Peter, Tonight, WFP champion and Philadelphia City Councilmember Nicolas O’Rourke will deliver the Working Families Party response to President Biden's State of the Union Address. In his response, Councilmember O’Rourke will help us make meaning of what is happening right now in U.S. politics, lay out our vision for the nation we’re trying to build together, and share our political strategy for 2024, including how we can block MAGA extremists and build working-class power nationwide. If we want to emerge from 2024 stronger than we are today, then we need a united movement of working people — bridged by our moral clarity and a shared vision for our collective futures — to stand across our differences, and create change. We’re in an era of compounding crises, Peter, with injustices prevailing everywhere from workplaces, to schools, to courtrooms, to the environment, to Gaza. The list is endless. This year’s WFP State of the Union response will map out a pathway through and beyond these crises, so we can forge a future where peace, justice and dignity for everyone prevails — and we’re so honored to have Nicolas O’Rourke deliver it. body:
We're one step closer to defeating Ted Cruz.
#
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em24307-1-tt&refcode2=5234.196590.HJAWbH&t=1&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)
---
Friend, I’m Colin Allred, and I'm the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Ted Cruz.
**Now, the real fight begins.** I'm ready to outwork, outraise, and out-organize Ted Cruz to win this thing, and with multiple polls already showing me TIED with Ted, I'm confident we can do it. But I also know Cruz is backed by wealthy mega donors who will spend whatever it takes to keep him in office.
**That’s why I need you with me: Please, will you chip in $5 – or whatever you can spare – to help reach my $1 million General Election Kickoff goal?**
**[Every dollar you can spare will power our people-powered movement through Election Day so we can defeat Ted Cruz and deliver better, stronger leadership for the people of Texas. Will you help kick our campaign off in a huge way by donating $5 or more to me and The Long Run right now?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em24307-1-tt&t=2&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)

[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.b8lq5e&refcode=em24307-1-tt&t=22&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.L4odF1&refcode=em24307-1-tt&t=23&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.t95SKi&refcode=em24307-1-tt&t=24&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.1D4yMD&refcode=em24307-1-tt&t=25&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em24307-1-tt&t=26&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)
I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.**
_Now, I’m ready for my next challenge:_ firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done.
**[That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a General Election Founding Donor and help reach our ambitious $1 million goal. We need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Ted Cruz, and I’m counting on you to be a part of it. Please, rush $5, or whatever you can spare, to help me and The Long Run win in Texas, defeat Ted Cruz, and give Texans the leadership we deserve. →**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em24307-1-tt&t=27&akid=5234%2E196590%2EHJAWbH)
Thank you so much for being a part of my team. Your support has gotten me this far, and it's why I know we can win.
Let's do this,
Colin Allred

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Why I’m running for re-election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
If you’re in a place where you can make a contribution to support my re-election campaign today, it will be a huge help.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1952%2E4032634%2EeWUAhe)
---
I’ll get right to it: [**If you’re in a place where you can make a contribution to support my re-election campaign today, it will be a huge help.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1911?t=8&akid=1952%2E4032634%2EeWUAhe) Now, you might be wondering why exactly a donation _today_ is so important. Let me explain: Less than a month ago, a Republican challenger — from Rhode Island — entered the Massachusetts Senate race against me. That unlocks an opportunity for national Republicans, billionaires, and corporate interests to invest in getting me — and the plans we’re fighting for — out of office. The amount that we raise right now in response will determine how strong we can compete — and how much we can invest in campaigning for our plans. We not only have to spend the next year fighting back against MAGA extremism — but also against a system that benefits from the status quo and says that big change is “impossible.” **That’s why I’m running for re-election — to stop MAGA extremism, build on the progress we’ve made so far in Massachusetts, and deliver the big, structural change our country still needs.** I’m talking with people across Massachusetts about the issues affecting their families and campaigning for bold policies that will transform the lives of working people across the country. Policies like creating affordable child care and housing. Holding big corporations accountable and bringing down costs. Reimagining our tax code and passing a wealth tax. **But first, we’ve got to win this race — and we’re competing against interests who want to put a stop to these policies. Special interests will look for any signs of weakness as they plan on where to invest in 2024. That’s why it’s incredibly important that we raise a competitive amount of grassroots contributions right now so we can run a strong campaign for our plans.** [**So can you please make a contribution of $28 or anything you can to ensure we respond to my opponent’s campaign launch with as much grassroots support as possible? This is an important moment where we need to demonstrate the strength of our movement.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1911?amount=28&t=9&akid=1952%2E4032634%2EeWUAhe)

TO: President Biden
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: I’m so grateful.

**Dear President Biden,

I’m so thankful for everything you’ve done as President!

**Despite MAGA turmoil, over the last three years, you’ve fought TIRELESSLY for the American people — defending abortion rights, confirming an incredible Supreme Court Justice, saving Social Security from GOP cuts, and creating millions of jobs for the people.**

I know standing up to MAGA Republican attacks isn’t easy, but it is always the right thing to do.

So as the 2024 race kicks into high gear, I wanted to show my support and thank you for being such an amazing leader for our country!

[**I hope you know that there are MILLIONS of us across the nation who stand with you. That’s why I’m signing this letter and chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to thank you and to keep electing incredible Democrats up and down the ballot »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/63716?t=9&akid=13297%2E878179%2Ec2LMcp)** | [SPACE RUNNING OUT: Donate $3 to sign now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/63716?t=10&akid=13297%2E878179%2Ec2LMcp)

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
MARCH 7, 2024
#
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**FORMER MAYOR FAULCONER RECEIVES BACKING FROM THE LARGEST POLICE UNION IN SAN DIEGO COUNTY**

SAN DIEGO, CA -- Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, announces the endorsement of the San Diego Police Officers Association. This endorsement is the latest sign of momentum for the former Mayor, who has made public safety a top issue in the race against incumbentTerra Lawson-Remer. Prior to this endorsement, Faulconer secured the support of the San Diego Deputy District Attorneys Association.

Incorporated in 1953 to assist San Diego police officers in issues related to wages, hours, and working conditions, the San Diego Police Officers Association (SDPOA) ensures officers receive due process and educate the community about the challenges faced by police departments and their officers. The SDPOA also aids members and their families in sickness, distress, and death, and strives to improve social relations and welfare among the members.

**“Kevin Faulconer has been a stalwart supporter of our men and women in blue. That’s why we’re supporting him to be our next County Supervisor,” said Jared Wilson, President of the San Diego Police Officers Association. “When other cities around the state looked to defund the police, Kevin stood up to these radical groups and instead gave us the tools necessary to help us be successful in protecting every day San Diegans. That’s the kind of leader we all need at the county level – that's why we’re strongly backing him to be our next Supervisor.”**

**“Too often we see elected officials like Terra Lawson-Remer cozy up to the type of groups that are friendly to the defund the police movement,” said former Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for Supervisor. “Just last year, she held a fundraiser with a Hollywood celebrity that supports the idea of taking away police funding and that’s wrong. When I was Mayor, we funded the police at record levels because it was the right thing to do. Even as protestors around my house demanded that I defund the police, I didn’t cave in. I stood up to these extreme activists and gave our police the tools and resources necessary for them to keep us the safest big city in the country. As Supervisor, I will continue to support our men and women who put their lives on the line so that we can rest easy at night.”**
As Mayor of San Diego, Faulconer worked tirelessly to provide the tools and resources necessary to support the San Diego Police Department. Under his tenure, the City of San Diego approved the most sweeping recruitment and retention program in the City’s history. And by the end of his tenure, the San Diego Police Department reached a 10-year high in staffing levels, fulfilling a key promise Mayor Faulconer had made to the community when he took office.

Since entering the race in July of 2023, Faulconer has outraised Terra Lawson-Remer, garnering support from local donors and attracted a growing number of endorsements from local organizations, including the San Diego Deputy District Attorneys Association, The San Diego Farm Bureau, San Diego Working Waterfront, The Lincoln Club Business League, San Diego Restaurant Association, Building Industry Association, Associated General Contractors of San Diego, and Associated Builders and Contractors of San Diego. As Supervisor, he’ll lead on pressing issues like reducing homelessness on day one – working to clean up the streets and get people the help they need to turn their lives around, just as he did as Mayor of San Diego, where he presided over double-digit decreases in homelessness.

To learn more about Kevin Faulconer and his campaign for Supervisor, visit www.kevinfaulconer.com

body:
It’s a stark example of what will happen nationwide — even here in Michigan— if MAGA extremists have their way and win back the House.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80523685/459603439/1433120897?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZWVhYTQwMy1jZmRjLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S-3CTUDNF7d82InVz5vXDZI9fmfSSDh5uJWKq0RhuWk=) A court in Alabama has ruled that frozen embryos should legally be considered children. As a result, IVF treatments are effectively banned in the state. **This ruling is dangerous to everybody – and it is devastating to the 1 in 6 Americans who need fertility treatments to have children and grow their families.** This is yet another dangerous consequence of our post-Roe world. Peter, Tina is taking action on the fentanyl crisis in downtown Portland. Several weeks ago, she — along with Portland Mayor Ted Wheeler and Multnomah County Chair Jessica Vega Pederson — declared a 90 day state of emergency around fentanyl in the Portland Central City neighborhoods. The tri-government coalition is now working to better align community safety and public health resources, improve access to addiction services, reduce overdoses, and crack down on illegal activity. Fentanyl is a dangerous drug — tiny amounts can be deadly — and we’ve lost too many Oregonians to this crisis. This focused state of emergency will allow leaders to maximize efforts and resources to curb preventable deaths, increase access to treatment, and help keep our streets safer. body:
https://www.wileynickel.com/ [https://www.wileynickel.com/]
Tomorrow is International Women's Day. Ahead of this very special day, I wanted to show my heartfelt appreciation to the remarkable women who contribute so much to our lives.
This day serves as a reminder of the strides we’ve made in achieving gender equality and the work that still lies ahead. I’m so thankful for all the great women who have helped shape my life and stood by my side on this journey. I couldn’t do any of this without them.
I was raised by a trailblazing woman. My mom was one of the first women to be a television “newsreader” in the 70’s. It was a time when women weren’t welcomed in the newsroom, but my mom helped put a big crack in that glass ceiling.
http://www.wileynickel.com/ [http://www.wileynickel.com/]
As a husband and a father to a wonderful daughter, Adeline, I’m aware of the profound impact that strong, empowered women can have on our families, communities, and society at large. I see the world through her eyes and want her to grow up in a world where anything is possible.
https://www.wileynickel.com/ [https://www.wileynickel.com/]
For that to happen, we have to ensure that women are empowered to make their own decisions about their futures. and I'm committed to protecting that right.
I encourage each of you to take a moment today to reflect on the achievements of the incredible women in your lives, express gratitude, and consider how we can continue working together to build a more just and equal society for all.
http://www.wileynickel.com/ [http://www.wileynickel.com/]
On this International Women's Day, let us continue working together for positive change.
All the best,
Wiley

Dear Friend,

You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty.

Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2e01e61730b241b3b12fde518bd5f2e5&_e=6OYsl0H9y3KlCRP6w2Z3e5r8OkC-FWtd8wjjtT9fArL8Ry_TKCHrXSZAnClBYFjVbmwut9rjhnarhRz04eyZCB6ACmTpStf7-jqYw5ylJTr4UDF8J-ORYsYJt71OfK8h-QZxYds8I5Iim_52UhOXsrJQci7GxXngM2-Dahk_2Qdws-viCjNv9eBiEETI2m7Tu-zh5p-JPy3VnJljtdvsvzxV3-do6iJgdPEvEi6YqVs7YVCeYoOF5E7HDhX9tw-zv0PEY9V07iVtJ5_JxbONxFbqLlJEKG3UkflmmVqrRVOW6Y4MQft11b7qUnEkWMSHlphLnsQgkQUFmf_DZyzMbGBu9EQfRybSMSIcxUUx9R-FudC1IzZ_RuHSIxFyCoIb_4gw99UX1N81yysbnnWrOXz3c89jdETF266XYMNGioI%3D)

Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."**

Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion."

These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties.

You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course.

**The first step is ...EDUCATION.**

Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.**

I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2e01e61730b241b3b12fde518bd5f2e5&_e=6OYsl0H9y3KlCRP6w2Z3e5r8OkC-FWtd8wjjtT9fArL8Ry_TKCHrXSZAnClBYFjVbmwut9rjhnarhRz04eyZCB6ACmTpStf7-jqYw5ylJTr4UDF8J-ORYsYJt71OfK8h-QZxYds8I5Iim_52UhOXsrJQci7GxXngM2-Dahk_2Qdws-viCjNv9eBiEETI2m7Tu-zh5p-JPy3VnJljtdvsvzxV3-do6iJgdPEvEi6YqVs7YVCeYoOF5E7HDhX9tw-zv0PEY9V07iVtJ5_JxbONxB3CjpYtaamUKP5toyKAkvVvRAQW0eeiM-qqVORl8uRGvAiEEQOUNA3dIb7740O9xYGmG_vOQhKhg7v8UTUrYOCl7EZhyxjt0I0xwlJTMWDynGb2FNVuOKfLimDScJvc3V9By6KSx5PvG7y2Sq-U4F8%3D)

Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.

But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.**

| | For Immediate Release
March 7, 2024
Contact: Tim Rosales | 916.475.4900
**Michael Maher closes in on Costa in the Central Valley. The Navy and Law Enforcement Veteran Shows CA-21 Congressional is a Leading Flip Target in California. **
Fresno - While the votes are still being counted, the early returns show that CA-21 could be one of the most competitive potential GOP pick-ups in California.

Navy and Law Enforcement Veteran Michael Maher has a narrow gap between him and Democrat incumbent Jim Costa, despite the Democrat registration advantage.

"The time has come for a new, dynamic leader to emerge—one who champions the aspirations of every individual in our region, not just the privileged few favored by Jim Costa. Our Primary Election results have exceeded all expectations, igniting a spark of excitement that will blaze a trail straight through to November," said Michael Maher.

Born and raised in California, Michael Maher is a Navy Veteran who enlisted after graduating from Tulare High School in 2001. Maher attended the U.S. Navy's Nuclear Power School, serving aboard the USS Salt Lake City SSN-716, a Los Angeles Class Fast Attack Submarine. He's a graduate of Fresno Pacific University and the FBI Academy in Quantico, Virginia.

Maher is married and has two children. His wife Anne comes from a multigenerational farming family in California’s central valley. Michael currently owns and operates a Central Valley based aviation business.

|
#
Peter,

Last night I called Dave Min to congratulate him on becoming the presumptive Democratic nominee for California’s 47th Congressional district. I offered him my best wishes and pledged to do all I can to keep CA-47 blue.

I am immensely grateful to have earned your trust and confidence and of so many people across Orange County, the state, and the country. Thank you for your support during this campaign – whether you donated, knocked on doors, or told a friend about our movement, every bit helped.

While this certainly isn’t the outcome we hoped for, I know we all worked hard to win this election. We mobilized communities across the district with our message prioritizing reproductive rights, protecting our coastlines, and creating an economy that works for everyone.

We must work together to defeat Scott Baugh in November, and we must ensure we have a Democratic House majority that prioritizes Orange County families and women’s reproductive freedom. Although I am no longer a candidate for CA-47, our work continues!

In unity,

Joanna

subject: The world needs permanent ceasefire NOW
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktSTmelEOWkn41hK1ictNLL7BTYyKcUpMngBiZl-Tl7iT&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=030724_ceasefire&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, Recently, the Biden administration proposed an emergency spending bill that would provide Israel with another 14 billion dollars in military aid. The bill passed the Senate and is awaiting passage in the House. Israel's assault on Gaza has already left over 30,000 people dead (70% of them women and children), including 70,000 injured and 2 million people displaced. **What purpose can another 14 billion serve except to slaughter more people and prolong the conflict?** Vice President Kamala Harris recently called for an immediate six-week ceasefire to free the hostages and let in more humanitarian aid. There are reports that her original speech was harsher on Israel about the dire humanitarian situation in Gaza and the need for more assistance than what was in the speech that was delivered, but the National Security Council softened it. **What kind of "national security" is gained by allowing this war to continue?** We need more than a temporary ceasefire in Gaza. The people of Gaza need a permanent ceasefire and immediate, massive humanitarian aid to stave off starvation and disease. Nothing less will do. **What ultimate good will come out of a temporary ceasefire when, after it is over, Israel resumes its military assault?** America's reputation as the leader of the "rules-based international order" is already in tatters for its enabling of what the International Court of Justice called "plausible claims" of genocide committed by Israel as presented by South Africa to the court. Providing billions more in military aid to Israel, allowing them to "finish the job," will strip us of any further legitimacy. **No more military aid to Israel! Ceasefire Now!** Our campaign is built on the belief that we must champion a pro-peace, human-rights-centered approach to politics. We cannot stand idly by while decisions that contradict these values are made in our name. **[Your support is crucial. Together, we can raise our voices against the continuation of military aid, which only prolongs conflict and suffering.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktSTmelEOWkn41hK1ictNLL7BTYyKcUpMngBiZl-Tl7iT&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=030724_ceasefire&n=2)**

---
Friend, There has been no let up in the NATO drive for the hybrid warfare confrontation against Russia. France's President Macron said on Feb. 29, "We will do everything to prevent Russia from winning this war." But as competent analysts have been saying for months on end, it is strategically impossible for Ukraine to defeat Russia on its stated terms. Throughout the past two years of this geopolitical farce, Russian President Putin has several times over stated unflinchingly the Russian policy to use its extensive arsenal of nuclear weapons in the case where the continued existence of Russia were to be threatened militarily. In his address to the American People on the Nuclear Test Ban Treaty in 1963, President John Kennedy quoted Russian Premier Khrushchev on the threat of nuclear war, saying, "the survivors would envy the dead." Will the incompetents and pathological liars in the State Department and Pentagon push us to the brink of the an actual open hot war with Russia in 2024? We do not know. Nor do the Russians. Hence, the extreme danger of thermonuclear war today. Join me for a discussion of the present war danger with expert Steven Starr and LaRouche candidate for Congressional District NY-15, Jose Vega. clean_body: Nikki Haley just dropped out of the GOP presidential primary, making it clear Donald Trump will be the Republican nominee. | | | I wanted to take a second to speak directly with you about the state of the race. I hope you’ll read this whole email and, if you’re able, Donald Trump swept through Super Tuesday, and yesterday Nikki Haley exited the GOP primary. Now it’s clear: Donald Trump will be the Republican nominee. The American people are left with a clear choice: Are we going to keep moving forward? Or will we allow Donald Trump to drag us backwards into the chaos, division, and darkness that defined his term in office? When I launched my campaign for reelection, I said that I believed every generation has a moment where they have had to stand up for democracy. To stand up for their fundamental freedoms. And that this was ours. That couldn’t be more true today. We know who Donald Trump is, and we know what he does. Heck, we know that he is willing to sacrifice our democracy to put himself in power. And we cannot let him take us backwards. I am asking you to pitch in to this campaign for the first time today. If you’ve been waiting on a moment to get involved in this campaign, Peter, this is it. But let me promise you one thing: This campaign isn’t about me. And it never will be. This campaign is about all of us. It’s about OUR future together. And that is why I want you to be a part of it. Since Day One, Kamala's and my goal has been to give folks a little more breathing room. To make your lives a little freer. We’ve made real progress these last few years, and we’re ready to finish the job. Millions of voters across the country made their voices heard on Tuesday -- showing that they are also ready to fight back against Donald Trump’s extreme plan to take us backwards. But we’re counting on millions more to join this grassroots team to defeat him this November. The question before us now is whether we’ll have more freedoms or fewer in the years ahead. More rights, or fewer. I know what I want the answer to be, and I think you do too. More soon, Joe Joe Biden President of the United States P.S. Six million grassroots donors invested in my campaign in 2020 so that we could defeat Donald Trump. We’ll need that same level of support to defeat him again this year.
